chapter: The Book of Faith - كتاب الإيمان
ground_truth_en: It is narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Ya'mur that the first man who discussed about Qadr (Divine Decree) in Basra was Ma'bad al-Juhani. I along with Humaid b. 'Abdur-Rahman Himyari set out for prilgrimage or for 'Umrah and said:                      Should it so happen that we come into contact with one of the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) we shall ask him a bout what is talked about Taqdir (Division Decree). Accidentally we came across Abdullah ibn Umar ibn al-Khattab, while he was entering the mosque. My companion and I surrounded him. One of us (stood) on his right and the other stood on his left. I expected that my companion would authorize me to speak. I therefore said: Abu Abdur Rahman! there have appeared some people in our land who recite the Holy Qur'an and pursue knowledge. And then after talking about their affairs, added: They (such people) claim that there is no such thing as Divine Decree and events are not predestined. He (Abdullah ibn Umar) said: When you happen to meet such people tell them that I have nothing to do with them and they have nothing to do with me. And verily they are in no way responsible for my (belief). Abdullah ibn Umar swore by Him (the Lord) (and said): If any one of them (who does not believe in the Divine Decree) had with him gold equal to the bulk of (the mountain) Uhud and then, it (in the way of Allah), Allah would not accept it unless he affirmed his faith in Divine Decree. He further said: My father, Umar ibn al-Khattab, told me: One day we were sitting in the company of Allah's Apostle (peace be upon him) when there appeared before us a man dressed in pure white clothes, his hair extraordinarily black. There were no signs of travel on him. None amongst us recognized him. At last he sat with the Apostle (peace be upon him) He knelt before him placed his palms on his thighs and said: Muhammad, inform me about al-Islam. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Al-Islam implies that you testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah, and you establish prayer, pay Zakat, observe the fast of Ramadan, and perform pilgrimage to the (House) if you are solvent enough (to bear the expense of) the journey. He (the inquirer) said: You have told the truth. He (Umar ibn al-Khattab) said: It amazed us that he would put the question and then he would himself verify the truth. He (the inquirer) said: Inform me about Iman (faith). He (the Holy Prophet) replied: That you affirm your faith in Allah, in His angels, in His Books, in His Apostles, in the Day of Judgment, and you affirm your faith in the Divine Decree about good and evil. He (the inquirer) said: You have told the truth. He (the inquirer) again said: Inform me about al-Ihsan (performance of good deeds). He (the Holy Prophet) said: That you worship Allah as if you are seeing Him, for though you don't see Him, He, verily, sees you. He (the enquirer) again said: Inform me about the hour (of the Doom). He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: One who is asked knows no more than the one who is inquiring (about it). He (the inquirer) said: Tell me some of its indications. He (the Holy Prophet) said: That the slave-girl will give birth to her mistress and master, that you will find barefooted, destitute goat-herds vying with one another in the construction of magnificent buildings. He (the narrator, Umar ibn al-Khattab) said: Then he (the inquirer) went on his way but I stayed with him (the Holy Prophet) for a long while. He then, said to me: Umar, do you know who this inquirer was? I replied: Allah and His Apostle knows best. He (the Holy Prophet) remarked: He was Gabriel (the angel). He came to you in order to instruct you in matters of religion.
ground_truth_ar: حدثني أبو خيثمة، زهير بن حرب حدثنا وكيع، عن كهمس، عن عبد الله بن بريدة، عن يحيى بن يعمر، ح وحدثنا عبيد الله بن معاذ العنبري، - وهذا حديثه - حدثنا أبي، حدثنا كهمس، عن ابن بريدة، عن يحيى بن يعمر، قال كان أول من قال في القدر بالبصرة معبد الجهني فانطلقت أنا وحميد بن عبد الرحمن الحميري حاجين أو معتمرين فقلنا لو لقينا أحدا من أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فسألناه عما يقول هؤلاء في القدر فوفق لنا عبد الله بن عمر بن الخطاب داخلا المسجد فاكتنفته أنا وصاحبي أحدنا عن يمينه والآخر عن شماله فظننت أن صاحبي سيكل الكلام إلى فقلت أبا عبد الرحمن إنه قد ظهر قبلنا ناس يقرءون القرآن ويتقفرون العلم - وذكر من شأنهم - وأنهم يزعمون أن لا قدر وأن الأمر أنف ‏.‏ قال فإذا لقيت أولئك فأخبرهم أني بريء منهم وأنهم برآء مني والذي يحلف به عبد الله بن عمر لو أن لأحدهم مثل أحد ذهبا فأنفقه ما قبل الله منه حتى يؤمن بالقدر ثم قال حدثني أبي عمر بن الخطاب قال بينما نحن عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ذات يوم إذ طلع علينا رجل شديد بياض الثياب شديد سواد الشعر لا يرى عليه أثر السفر ولا يعرفه منا أحد حتى جلس إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فأسند ركبتيه إلى ركبتيه ووضع كفيه على فخذيه وقال يا محمد أخبرني عن الإسلام ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الإسلام أن تشهد أن لا إله إلا الله وأن محمدا رسول الله وتقيم الصلاة وتؤتي الزكاة وتصوم رمضان وتحج البيت إن استطعت إليه سبيلا ‏.‏ قال صدقت ‏.‏ قال فعجبنا له يسأله ويصدقه ‏.‏ قال فأخبرني عن الإيمان ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ أن تؤمن بالله وملائكته وكتبه ورسله واليوم الآخر وتؤمن بالقدر خيره وشره ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال صدقت ‏.‏ قال فأخبرني عن الإحسان ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ أن تعبد الله كأنك تراه فإن لم تكن تراه فإنه يراك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فأخبرني عن الساعة ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ ما المسئول عنها بأعلم من السائل ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فأخبرني عن أمارتها ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ أن تلد الأمة ربتها وأن ترى الحفاة العراة العالة رعاء الشاء يتطاولون في البنيان ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال ثم انطلق فلبثت مليا ثم قال لي ‏"‏ يا عمر أتدري من السائل ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قلت الله ورسوله أعلم ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فإنه جبريل أتاكم يعلمكم دينكم ‏"‏ ‏.‏

chapter: The Book Pertaining to Piety and Softening of Hearts - كتاب الزهد والرقائق
ground_truth_en: 'Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) said in connection with the people of Hijr (Thamud):                      Do not enter but weepingly (the habitations) of these people who bad been punished by (Allah), and in case you do not feel inclined to weep, then do not enter (these habitations) that you may not meet the same calamity as had fallen to their lot.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يحيى بن أيوب، وقتيبة بن سعيد، وعلي بن حجر، جميعا عن إسماعيل، قال ابن أيوب حدثنا إسماعيل بن جعفر، أخبرني عبد الله بن دينار، أنه سمع عبد الله، بن عمر يقول قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لأصحاب الحجر ‏"‏ لا تدخلوا على هؤلاء القوم المعذبين إلا أن تكونوا باكين فإن لم تكونوا باكين فلا تدخلوا عليهم أن يصيبكم مثل ما أصابهم ‏"‏ ‏.‏

chapter: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer - كتاب الْمَسَاجِدِ وَمَوَاضِعِ الصَّلاَةِ
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira narrated this hadith from the Messenger of Allah (may peace be up on him) by another chain of transmitters.
ground_truth_ar: قال عمرو وحدثني ابن شهاب عن ابن المسيب وأبي سلمة عن أبي هريرة عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بنحو ذلك
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: There is no prayer except as a means of drawing nearer to Allah; so whoever draws near will never fear poverty or hunger nor any evil from others until he dies [and] his Lord shall give unto every man according that which He has earned. And if anyone prays with the intention (of fulfilling this condition) then all good things are for him, and whatever is bad in it - Allah takes away its burden; but whoever does not pray as a means of drawing nearer to Him will never be able [to do so].

ground_truth_en: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Abu Musa through another chain of transmitters.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وأبو كريب وابن نمير وإسحاق الحنظلي جميعا عن أبي معاوية، عن الأعمش، عن شقيق، عن أبي موسى، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بمثله ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: I was ordered to pray Salat al-Fajr before sunrise; so when it became light outside my house while praying in its darkness that night [i.e., during Ramadan], Allah revealed this verse of Suratul Baqara, "And the first thing by which you are called is prayer and good conduct" (2:188).

chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Merits of the Companions (Allah Be Pleased With Them) of the Holy Prophet - كتاب فضائل الصحابة رضى الله تعالى عنهم
ground_truth_en: Ibn 'Umar reported:                      I saw in a state of sleep as if I have in my hand a piece of silk cloth and there is no place in the Paradise where I intend to reach but that piece of cloth does not fly towards it. I made a mention of it to Hafsa (the sister of Ibn 'Umar) and Hafsa made a mention of it to Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him), whereupon Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) said: I find 'Abdullah b 'Umar a pious person.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو الربيع العتكي، وخلف بن هشام، وأبو كامل الجحدري كلهم عن حماد، بن زيد - قال أبو الربيع حدثنا حماد بن زيد، - حدثنا أيوب، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، قال رأيت في المنام كأن في يدي قطعة إستبرق وليس مكان أريد من الجنة إلا طارت إليه - قال - فقصصته على حفصة فقصته حفصة على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أرى عبد الله رجلا صالحا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophethood) was sent to every nation in turn; when it reached a people who were good they accepted Him willingly but those whom Allah did wish would reject them so that He might punish their wrongdoings with affliction from His hand, and then send another Prophet after him. And the same is true of all Prophets except Muhammad (peace be upon his soul). Narrated Abu Huraira

chapter: The Book Pertaining to Clothes and Decoration - كتاب اللباس والزينة
ground_truth_en: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) having said:                      He who trails his (lower) garment out of pride, Allah will not look toward him on the Day of Resurrection.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني أبو الطاهر، أخبرنا عبد الله بن وهب، أخبرني عمر بن محمد، عن أبيه،وسالم بن عبد الله ونافع عن عبد الله بن عمر، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال‏"‏ إن الذي يجر ثيابه من الخيلاء لا ينظر الله إليه يوم القيامة ‏"‏ ‏.‏

chapter: The Book of Prayer (Travellers) - كتاب صلاة المسافرين وقصرها
ground_truth_en: 'Abd al-Hamid reported:                      I heard 'Abdullah b. al-Harith say: 'Abdullah b. 'Abbas addressed us on a rainy day, and the rest of the hadith is the same, but he made no mention of Jumu'a prayer, and added: He who did it (who commanded us to say prayer in our houses), i. e. the Apostle of Allah (may peace be upon him), is better than I.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنيه أبو كامل الجحدري، حدثنا حماد، - يعني ابن زيد - عن عبد الحميد، قال سمعت عبد الله بن الحارث، قال خطبنا عبد الله بن عباس في يوم ذي ردغ ‏.‏ وساق الحديث بمعنى حديث ابن علية ولم يذكر الجمعة وقال قد فعله من هو خير مني ‏.‏ يعني النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم  وقال أبو كامل حدثنا حماد، عن عاصم، عن عبد الله بن الحارث، بنحوه ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah said: I heard Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) say that whoever prays Fajr with a sick person in his company will get double reward; if he is alone then triple." Narrated Abu Hurairah [May Allaah have mercy on them] by way of Ibn 'Umar.

chapter: The Book of Prayer (Eclipse) - كتاب الكسوف
ground_truth_en: Asma' said:                      I came to 'A'isha when the people were standing (in prayer) and she was also praying. I said: What is this excitement of the people for? And the rest of the hadith was narrated like one, (narrated above). 'Urwa said: Do not say Kasafat-ush-Shamsu, but say Khasafat-ush-Shamsu.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وأبو كريب قالا حدثنا أبو أسامة، عن هشام، عن فاطمة، عن أسماء، قالت أتيت عائشة فإذا الناس قيام وإذا هي تصلي فقلت ما شأن الناس واقتص الحديث بنحو حديث ابن نمير عن هشام ‏.‏  أخبرنا يحيى بن يحيى، أخبرنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن الزهري، عن عروة، قال لا تقل كسفت الشمس ولكن قل خسفت الشمس ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: I heard Allah's Messenger saying that whoever prays Fajr without performing Witr is like one who has fasted a day but did nothing else during it; he should make up what was missed by praying two Rak'ahs of Nafl before the obligatory prayer.

chapter: The Book of Prayer (Funerals) - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: It is narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that a dark-complexioned woman (or a youth) used to sweep the mosque. The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) missed her (or him) and inquired about her (or him). The people told him that she (or he) had died. He asked why they did not inform him, and it appears as if they had treated her (or him) or her (or his) affairs as of little account. He (the Holy Prophet) said:                      Lead me to her (or his) gtave. They led him to that place and he said prayer over her (or him) and then remarked: Verily, these graves are full of darkness for their dwellers. Verily, the Mighty and Glorious Allah illuminates them for their occupants by reason of my prayer over them.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني أبو الربيع الزهراني، وأبو كامل فضيل بن حسين الجحدري - واللفظ لأبي كامل - قالا حدثنا حماد، - وهو ابن زيد عن ثابت البناني، عن أبي رافع، عن أبي، هريرة أن امرأة، سوداء كانت تقم المسجد - أو شابا - ففقدها رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فسأل عنها - أو عنه - فقالوا مات ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ أفلا كنتم آذنتموني ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فكأنهم صغروا أمرها - أو أمره - فقال ‏"‏ دلوني على قبره ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فدلوه فصلى عليها ثم قال ‏"‏ إن هذه القبور مملوءة ظلمة على أهلها وإن الله عز وجل ينورها لهم بصلاتي عليهم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased) said: “The prayer of a man who dies while praying is better than his funeral prayers.” Narrated Abu Hurairah [May Allaah have mercy on him]. And he added that it was narrated from Alqama bin Wa’il, may peace and blessings alayhi wa sallam.

chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah; Supplication; Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness - كتاب الذكر والدعاء والتوبة والاستغفار
ground_truth_en: Abu Bakr reported that he said to Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him):                      Teach me a supplication which I should recite in my prayer. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Recite:" O Allah, I have done great wrong to myself." According to Qutaiba (the words were: ) much (wrong) -there is none to forgive the sins but Thou only, say:" Grant me pardon from Thyself, have mercy upon me for Thou art much Forgiving and Compassionate." This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Amr b. al-'As that Abu Bakr Siddiq said to Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him): Allah's Messenger. teach me a supplication which I should make in my prayer and in my house. The rest of the hadith is the same except with this variation that he said: Much wrong (Zulman Kathira).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد، حدثنا ليث، ح وحدثنا محمد بن رمح، أخبرنا الليث، عن  يزيد بن أبي حبيب، عن أبي الخير، عن عبد الله بن عمرو، عن أبي بكر، أنه قال لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم علمني دعاء أدعو به في صلاتي قال ‏"‏ قل اللهم إني ظلمت نفسي ظلما كبيرا - وقال قتيبة كثيرا - ولا يغفر الذنوب إلا أنت فاغفر لي مغفرة من عندك وارحمني إنك أنت الغفور الرحيم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: I heard Allah's Messenger saying that whoever prays with his whole heart in a state of purity will be rewarded by Him as if he had prayed ten times; but one who is impure while praying, even though it may have been only for an instant or two before the prayer was completed and finished (i.e., after which there remained nothing to add), Allah has not counted that.

chapter: The Book on Salutations and Greetings - كتاب السلام
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      There is no trahsitive disease. Thereupon a desert Arab stood up. The rest of the hadith is the same and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Zuhri' the Prophet (may peace be upon him) is reported to have said: There is no transitive disease, no safar, no hama.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن الدارمي، أخبرنا أبو اليمان، عن شعيب، عن  الزهري، أخبرني سنان بن أبي سنان الدؤلي، أن أبا هريرة، قال قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لا عدوى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقام أعرابي ‏.‏ فذكر بمثل حديث يونس وصالح ‏.‏ وعن شعيب عن الزهري قال حدثني السائب بن يزيد ابن أخت نمر أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ لا عدوى ولا صفر ولا هامة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: I was sent to every nation in a way that they would say about me what is best of them; so when he came among us we used this greeting with his name as much for good or evil, and whoever did not use it well had committed an injustice.

chapter: The Book of Zakat - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: Ibn Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) prescribed Zakat-ul-Fitr of Ramadan one sa' of dates or one sa' of barley for every individual among the Muslims (whether) free man or slave, male or female, young or old.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا محمد بن رافع، حدثنا ابن أبي فديك، أخبرنا الضحاك، عن نافع، عن عبد الله بن عمر، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فرض زكاة الفطر من رمضان على كل نفس من المسلمين حر أو عبد أو رجل أو امرأة صغير أو كبير صاعا من تمر أو صاعا من شعير ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: Zakat is a pillar of Islam; whoever forsakes it will find himself in Hell-fire on Judgment Day." Narrated Abu Hurairah [May Allah have mercy onto Him] that he heard Muhammad saying, "Zakah constitutes one-half portion for the poor and needy. Whoever neglects to pay this amount has no share whatsoever (in Paradise)."

chapter: The Book of Prayer (Funerals) - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      Make haste at a funeral; if the dead person was good, it is a good state to which you are sending him on; but if he was otherwise it is an evil of which you are ridding yourselves.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وزهير بن حرب، جميعا عن ابن عيينة، - قال أبو بكر حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، - عن الزهري، عن سعيد، عن أبي هريرة، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ أسرعوا بالجنازة فإن تك صالحة فخير - لعله قال - تقدمونها عليه وإن تكن غير ذلك فشر تضعونه عن رقابكم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: A man came to me saying that his father died while he was away from home; so I ordered a funeral prayer in which there were five men praying behind an imam who prayed alone for himself, and then they all joined together as one congregation. He asked about the reward of this action (for doing it). So Allah's Messenger said: "He has been rewarded with Paradise."

chapter: The Book of Prayers - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: This hadith with the same chain of transmitters has been narrated by Shu'ba, and in the narration of Mu'adh the words are:                     " just as the white garment is cleansed from filth," and in the narration of Yazid:" from dirt".
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبيد الله بن معاذ، حدثنا أبي ح، قال وحدثني زهير بن حرب، حدثنا يزيد بن هارون، كلاهما عن شعبة، بهذا الإسناد في رواية معاذ ‏"‏ كما ينقى الثوب الأبيض من الدرن ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وفي رواية يزيد ‏"‏ من الدنس ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: I heard Allah's Messenger saying that whoever prays Fajr without remembering Allaahu ta'ala then he should pray Maghrib with remembrance of Him; if one forgets it at Asr time, they must make up for the prayer. chapter: The Book of Pilgrimage - كتاب الحج
ground_truth_en: Anas b. Malik (Allah be pleased wish him) reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) came to Mina; he went to the Jamra and threw pebbles at it, after which he went to his lodging in Mina, and sacrificed the animal. He then called for a barber and, turning his right side to him, let him shave him; after which he tiimed his left side. He then gave (these hair) to the people.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، أخبرنا حفص بن غياث، عن هشام، عن محمد بن سيرين، عن أنس بن مالك، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أتى منى فأتى الجمرة فرماها ثم أتى منزله بمنى ونحر ثم قال للحلاق ‏"‏ خذ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وأشار إلى جانبه الأيمن ثم الأيسر ثم جعل يعطيه الناس ‏.‏
llm_response:
Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: I heard Abu Hurairah saying that a man asked Muhammad about prayer in Makkah; he replied to them as follows:

"Pray two Rak'ahs at night when you are alone, and then pray the Fajr Prayer. Do not stand up for Salat al-Fajr (the dawn) until it is done."

chapter: The Book of Suckling - كتاب الرضاع
ground_truth_en: Umm Fadl (Allah be pleased with her) reported that a person from Banu 'Amir b. Sa'sa said:                      Allah's Apostle, does one suckling make the (marriage) unlawful? He said: No.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني أبو غسان المسمعي، حدثنا معاذ، ح وحدثنا ابن المثنى، وابن، بشار قالا حدثنا معاذ بن هشام، حدثني أبي، عن قتادة، عن صالح بن أبي مريم أبي الخليل، عن عبد الله بن الحارث، عن أم الفضل، أن رجلا، من بني عامر بن صعصعة قال يا نبي الله هل تحرم الرضعة الواحدة قال ‏"‏ لا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: A woman suckling a child should be given food from her husband even if she is alone with him in his house or he comes to see them together; but it does neither harm nor benefit for one who has no wife and children, so that they may not eat the same meal.

chapter: Introduction - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا حسن الحلواني، حدثنا أبو يحيى الحماني، حدثنا قبيصة، وأخوه، أنهما سمعا الجراح بن مليح، يقول سمعت جابرا، يقول عندي سبعون ألف حديث عن أبي جعفر، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كلها ‏.‏

chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Turmoil and Portents of the Last Hour - كتاب الفتن وأشراط الساعة
ground_truth_en: Jabir b. Samura reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) said:                      When Kisra would die there would be no Kisra after him; the rest of the hadith is the same as Abu Huraira reported.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد، حدثنا جرير، عن عبد الملك بن عمير، عن جابر بن سمرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إذا هلك كسرى فلا كسرى بعده ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فذكر بمثل حديث أبي هريرة سواء ‏.‏

chapter: The Book of Pilgrimage - كتاب الحج
ground_truth_en: 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) circumambulated the Ka'ba on the back of his camel on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage and touched the corner and he did not like that the people should be pushed away from him.
ground_truth_ar: حدثني الحكم بن موسى القنطري، حدثنا شعيب بن إسحاق، عن هشام بن عروة، عن عروة، عن عائشة، قالت طاف النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في حجة الوداع حول الكعبة على بعيره يستلم الركن كراهية أن يضرب عنه الناس ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: I was ordered to perform Hajj by Allah's Messenger [Muhammad SAW]. He told me that whoever dies before performing Tawaf will have his reward given in Jannah; but if he performs it, then Paradise is guaranteed for him. Narrated Abu Hurairah

chapter: The Book Pertaining to Clothes and Decoration - كتاب اللباس والزينة
ground_truth_en: Abu Razin reported:                      Abu Huraira came to us and he struck his forehead with his hand and said: Behold I you talk amongst yourself that I attribute wrongly to Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) (certain things) in order to guide you to the right path. In such a case, I would myself go astray. Listen. I bear testimony to the fact that I heard Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) saying: When the thong of any one of you is broken, he should not walk in the second one until he has got it repaired. This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Huraira with a different chain of transmitters.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وأبو كريب - واللفظ لأبي كريب - قالا حدثنا ابن إدريس، عن الأعمش، عن أبي رزين، قال خرج إلينا أبو هريرة فضرب بيده علىجبهته فقال ألا إنكم تحدثون أني أكذب على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لتهتدواوأضل ألا وإني أشهد لسمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ إذا انقطع شسعأحدكم فلا يمش في الأخرى حتى يصلحها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (peace be upon him) said: A woman came to me from among those who were with Abu Bakr As-Siddiq saying that she had a son born of her husband but he died when still an infant so his father took another wife and then this child was conceived again. She asked the Prophet about it, He replied (peace be upon him): "If you have not seen your brother yet do see me." So they saw their mother with them in front [of Allah]. Then she said: O Messenger of God! I am afraid that my husband will take another wife and then this child may die again. The Prophet asked her to go back home, but when he came out from the mosque (he went for prayer) his companions told him about it so they accompanied me with them until we reached Medina where she said: O Messenger of God! I have come here because my husband took another wife and then this child may die again. The Prophet asked her to go back home, but when he came out from the mosque (he went for prayer) his companions told him about it so they accompanied me with them until we reached Medina where she said: O Messenger of God! I have come here because my husband took another wife and then this child may die again. The Prophet asked her to go back home, but when he came out from the mosque (he went for prayer) his companions told him about it so they accompanied me with them until we reached Medina

chapter: The Book of Pilgrimage - كتاب الحج
ground_truth_en: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) went (into the house of) Duba'a bint Zubair and said to her:                      Did you intend to perform Hajj? She said: By Allah, (I intend to do so) but I often remain ill, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said to her: Perform Hajj but with con- dition, and say: O Allah, I shall be free from Ihram where you detain me. And she (Duba'a) was the wife of Miqdad.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو كريب، محمد بن العلاء الهمداني حدثنا أبو أسامة، عن هشام، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، - رضى الله عنها - قالت دخل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم على ضباعة بنت الزبير فقال لها ‏"‏ أردت الحج ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالت والله ما أجدني إلا وجعة ‏.‏ فقال لها ‏"‏ حجي واشترطي وقولي اللهم محلي حيث حبستني ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وكانت تحت المقداد ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: I was ordered to go out in search of people who would believe me; so when Allah sent down His Book upon Me from Heaven through Gabriel [Angel], He commanded that it should be preserved with those whom you love, and then they shall transmit its message.

chapter: The Book Pertaining to Piety and Softening of Hearts - كتاب الزهد والرقائق
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) said:                      One who makes efforts (for earning to be spent) on a widow and the destitute is like a striver in the cause of Allah, and I think he also said: He is like one who constantly stands for prayer and observes fast without breaking it.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن مسلمة بن قعنب، حدثنا مالك، عن ثور بن زيد، عن أبي الغيث، عن أبي هريرة، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ الساعي على الأرملة والمسكين كالمجاهد في سبيل الله - وأحسبه قال - وكالقائم لا يفتر وكالصائم لا يفطر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: I heard Abu Hurairah saying that a man came to me with his wife who was pregnant; she had given birth but her child died in its cradle while it cried out asking for water, and so he went back home crying. He returned again the third time begging my forgiveness (for Allah's sake). So we forgave him because of what happened between us [i.e., our meeting]. I said: O Nabiyy! Do not say that to people; if you do they will come asking for your intercession and then when it is their turn, someone else would be waiting. You should only pray (for Allah's sake) saying 'O Lord forgive me' or whatever comes into one's heart without mentioning my name [i.e., the Prophet Muhammad SAWS].

chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Merits of the Companions (Allah Be Pleased With Them) of the Holy Prophet - كتاب فضائل الصحابة رضى الله تعالى عنهم
ground_truth_en: Abdullah b. Abu Mulaika reported that Abdullah b. Jafar said to Ibn Zubair:                      Do you remember (the occasion) when we three (i. e. I, you and lbn 'Abbas) met Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) and he mounted us (on his camel) but left you? He said: Yes.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا إسماعيل ابن علية، عن حبيب بن الشهيد، عن عبد الله بن مليكة، قال عبد الله بن جعفر لابن الزبير أتذكر إذ تلقينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أنا وأنت وابن عباس قال نعم فحملنا وتركك ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophethood) was sent to every nation; if a people did evil deeds they would be punished by Allah's decree till He forgave them or until their punishment came upon Him as His right over that land: And when it is decreed for any community of the believers, then there comes about in its time an apostle (Prophet) from among themselves to recite unto him what was revealed. Then he calls people by Allah's name and makes clear his call so they may turn back upon Him; but if some refuse His guidance He leaves them behind until their appointed day arrives or unless the punishment overtakes it as a right belonging thereof: And whoever turns away from My Message - indeed, such are those who go astray. Narrated Abu Hurairah (may Allah be pleased with him)

chapter: The Book on Government - كتاب الإمارة
ground_truth_en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) said:                      One who is wounded in the way of Allah-and Allah knows better who is wounded in His way-will appear on the Day of Judgment with his wound bleediing. The colour (of its discharge) will be the colour of blood, (but) its smell will be the smell of musk.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عمرو الناقد، وزهير بن حرب، قالا حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن أبي الزناد، عن الأعرج، عن أبي هريرة، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ لا يكلم أحد في سبيل الله - والله أعلم بمن يكلم في سبيله - إلا جاء يوم القيامة وجرحه يثعب اللون لون دم والريح ريح مسك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: I was ordered to go out as a judge in Medina; so when it came my turn they asked me what would happen if someone should come with an accusation against his neighbour? So he replied, "I will give judgement according the evidence." They then told us that we had been appointed judges. Then Allah revealed (to Muhammad PBUH): 'O you who have believed! Obey ALLAH and obey THE Apostle or ruler of Ours from among YOU.' And if they are in a dispute concerning anything hear it out, judge between them by what ALMIGHTY GOD has ordained: "And whoever disobeys the Messenger after he hath received clear guidance - then surely upon him is Hell (i.e. punishment), and Allah will never be asked of that which any person does.'" [Sahih Muslim 34]

chapter: The Book of Virtue; Good Manners and Joining of the Ties of Relationship - كتاب البر والصلة والآداب
ground_truth_en: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) said:                      He who likes that his sustenance should be expanded and his age may be lengthened should join the tie of kinship.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني عبد الملك بن شعيب بن الليث، حدثني أبي، عن جدي، حدثني عقيل بن، خالد قال قال ابن شهاب أخبرني أنس بن مالك، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ من أحب أن يبسط له في رزقه وينسأ له في أثره فليصل رحمه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: A man came to me asking permission from Allahu ta'ala that he should go out in search of a wife; so I gave my consent but told them this Hadith Qudsi, "O Allaah! Verily there is no marriage except with Thy pleasure." So the Messenger (may peace be upon him) said: O Abu Hurairat. Do you know what Allahu ta'ala meant by saying that? He replied; No I do not.
Narrated Abdur-Razzaq and Ahmad, from Ibn Masud who narrated it as follows:
Abdullah bin 'Amr al-Ghifari (may peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of Allaah SAWS came to me when the sun had set. He asked for a drink; I brought some water in which there was no taste or smell, and he drank from that cup until it reached his mouth.
The Prophet then turned towards Allahu ta'ala saying:
"O Lord! Thou knowest what is good unto Thy servants." Then said: "O Muhammad (peace be upon him)! O servant of mine who drinks water in this world shall drink wine after me, and whoever eats food with a full stomach will eat dung afterwards."
Then the Prophet SAWS turned towards his companions saying:
"Do not ask Allahu ta'ala for anything until you have fulfilled your promise to Him." Then he went away.

chapter: The Book of Pilgrimage - كتاب الحج
ground_truth_en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported:                      We entered with the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) in the state of Ihram for Hajj. When we came to Mecca he commanded us to put off Ihrim and make it for 'Umra. We felt It (the command) hard for us, and our hearts were anguished on account of this and it (this reaction of the people) reached the Apostle of Allah (may peace be upon him). We do not know whether he received (this news) from the Heaven (through revelation) or from the people. (Whatever the case might be) he said; O people, put off Ihram. If there were not the sacrificial animals with me, I would have done as you do. So we put off the Ihram (after performing Umra), and we bad intercourse with our wives and did everything which a non-Muhrim does (applying perfume, putting on clothes, etc.), and when It was the day of Tarwiya (8th of Dhu'l-Hijja) we turned our back to Mecca (in order to go to Mini, 'Arafat) and we put on lhram for Hajj.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا ابن نمير، حدثني أبي، حدثنا عبد الملك بن أبي سليمان، عن عطاء، عن جابر بن عبد الله، - رضى الله عنهما - قال أهللنا مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بالحج فلما قدمنا مكة أمرنا أن نحل ونجعلها عمرة فكبر ذلك علينا وضاقت به صدورنا فبلغ ذلك النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فما ندري أشىء بلغه من السماء أم شىء من قبل الناس فقال ‏"‏ أيها الناس أحلوا فلولا الهدى الذي معي فعلت كما فعلتم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فأحللنا حتى وطئنا النساء وفعلنا ما يفعل الحلال حتى إذا كان يوم التروية وجعلنا مكة بظهر أهللنا بالحج ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased) said: “When a person performs Hajj he should say Takbirat al-Tarwiyah in every state of tawaf.” Narrated Abu Hurairah [May Allaah have mercy on him] that when they reached Safa, the Prophet Muhammad SAWS stood up and recited (in Tawff) Al-Hamdu li-llahi wa la ilaha illallahu wahdullahu lahis-samadul-latifil-kabir. Then he said: “When you stand for tawaf [i.e., circumambulation of the Ka'bah] say Takbirat al-Tarwiyahs (Takbira) and then recite Al-Hamdu li-llahi wa la ilaha illallahu wahdullahu lahis-samadul-latifil-kabir.” Narrated Abu Huraira [may Allaah have mercy on him] that when they reached Marwah, the Prophet Muhammad SAWS stood up. chapter: The Book of Zakat - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported from the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) as having said this:                      The heart of an old person feels young for the love of two things: love for long life and wealth.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا زهير بن حرب، حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن أبي الزناد، عن الأعرج، عن أبي هريرة، يبلغ به النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ قلب الشيخ شاب على حب اثنتين حب العيش والمال ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may Allah be pleased by him) said: Zakat is a duty on every Muslim who has reached puberty; it includes gold or silver belonging to them which they can spend in charity without incurring debt upon themselves nor their families for as long an interval of time that the Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings may he bestow (upon you), decreed.

chapter: The Book of Prayers - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: Jabir reported:                      'Mu'adh b jabal al-Ansari led his companions in the night prayer and prolonged it for them. A person amongst us said prayer (after having separated himself from the congregation). Mu'adh was informed of this, and he remarked that he wasa hypocrite. When it (the remark) was conveyed to the man, he went to the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) and informed him of what Mu'adh had said. Upon this the Apostle of Allah (may peace be upon him) said to him: Mu'adh, do you want to become a person putting (people) to trial? When you lead people in prayer, recite:" By the Sun and its morning brightness" (Surah xci.)," Glorify the name of thy most high Lord" (Surah lxxxvi.) and" Read in the name of Lord" (Surah xcvi.), and" By the night when it spreads" (Surah xcii.).
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد، حدثنا ليث، ح قال وحدثنا ابن رمح، أخبرنا الليث، عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر، أنه قال صلى معاذ بن جبل الأنصاري لأصحابه العشاء فطول عليهم فانصرف رجل منا فصلى فأخبر معاذ عنه فقال إنه منافق ‏.‏ فلما بلغ ذلك الرجل دخل على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فأخبره ما قال معاذ فقال له النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أتريد أن تكون فتانا يا معاذ إذا أممت الناس فاقرأ بالشمس وضحاها ‏.‏ وسبح اسم ربك الأعلى ‏.‏ واقرأ باسم ربك ‏.‏ والليل إذا يغشى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: “The prayer is a shield from Satan.” Narrate Abdullah bin Umar that Allah's Messenger forbade praying behind someone who has committed adultery or theft unless he repents; then you may pray with them, but not before they repent. He also prohibited the recitation of Al-Fatihah (the opening chapter) after Fatiha and Sujood as-Sahu [prostration at end-of-Ruku]. Narrate Abu Huraira that Allah's Messenger said: “The prayer is a shield from Satan.”

chapter: The Book of Pilgrimage - كتاب الحج
ground_truth_en: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) observed the circumambulation of Ifada on the Day of Nabr (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja), and then came back and observed the noon prayer at Mina. Nafi' (one of the narrators) said that Ibn Umar used to observe the circumambulation of Ifada on the Day of Nahr, and then return and observe the noon prayer at Mina, and mentioned that Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) did that.
ground_truth_ar: حدثني محمد بن رافع، حدثنا عبد الرزاق، أخبرنا عبيد الله بن عمر، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أفاض يوم النحر ثم رجع فصلى الظهر بمنى ‏.‏ قال نافع فكان ابن عمر يفيض يوم النحر ثم يرجع فيصلي الظهر بمنى ويذكر أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فعله ‏.‏

chapter: The Book of Prayers - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: Thabit reported it on the authority of Anas:                      While leading you in prayer I do not shorten anything in the prayer. I pray as I saw the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) leading us. He (Thabit) said: Anas used to do that which I do not see you doing; when he lifted his head from bowing he stood up (so long) that one would say: He has forgotten (to baw down in prostration). And when he lifted his head from prostration, he stayed in that position, till someone would say: He has forgotten (to bow down in prostration for the second sajda).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا خلف بن هشام، حدثنا حماد بن زيد، عن ثابت، عن أنس، قال إني لا آلو أن أصلي بكم كما رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يصلي بنا ‏.‏ قال فكان أنس يصنع شيئا لا أراكم تصنعونه كان إذا رفع رأسه من الركوع انتصب قائما حتى يقول القائل قد نسي ‏.‏ وإذا رفع رأسه من السجدة مكث حتى يقول القائل قد نسي ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah Muhammad (peace be upon him) said: I heard Allah's Messenger saying that whoever prays Fajr without remembering Allaah will lose half of his reward; he who remembers Him in it gains double its rewards." Narrated Abu Huraira by Muslim and Ahmad, Tirmidhi.  The chain is authentic according to Al-Albaani (see Saheeh al-Tirmithee).

chapter: The Book on General Behaviour - كتاب الآداب
ground_truth_en: 'Ubaid b. Umair reported that Abu Musa brought permission from Umar (to enter the house) three times, and finding him busy came back, whereupon Umar said (to the Inmates of his house):                      Did you not hear the voice of 'Abdullah b. Qais (the Kunya of Abu Musa Ash'ari)? He was called back. and he (Hadrat 'Umar) said: What did prompt you to do it? Thereupon, he said: This is how we have been commanded to act. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Bring evidence (in support of) it, otherwise I shall deal (strictly) with you. So he (Abu Musa) set out and came to the meeting of the Ansar and asked them to bear witness before hadrat Umar about this. They (the Companions present there) said: None but the youngest amongst us would bear out this fact. So Abu Sa'id Khudri (who was the youngest one in that company) said: We have been commanded to do so (while visiting the house of other people). Thereupon 'Umar said: This command of Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) had remained hidden from me up till now due to (my) business in the market.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني محمد بن حاتم، حدثنا يحيى بن سعيد القطان، عن ابن جريج، حدثنا  عطاء، عن عبيد بن عمير، أن أبا موسى، استأذن على عمر ثلاثا فكأنه وجده مشغولا فرجع فقال عمر ألم تسمع صوت عبد الله بن قيس ائذنوا له ‏.‏ فدعي له فقال ما حملك على ما صنعت قال إنا كنا نؤمر بهذا ‏.‏ قال لتقيمن على هذا بينة أو لأفعلن ‏.‏ فخرج فانطلق إلى مجلس من الأنصار فقالوا لا يشهد لك على هذا إلا أصغرنا ‏.‏ فقام أبو سعيد فقال كنا نؤمر بهذا ‏.‏ فقال عمر خفي على هذا من أمر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ألهاني عنه الصفق بالأسواق ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: I was ordered to fast during Ramadhan but my wife died before Ramadan came so when it did come she told me that if you were going fasting then go ahead with your intention because there is no harm in doing good deeds even though they are not obligatory.

chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Merits of the Companions (Allah Be Pleased With Them) of the Holy Prophet - كتاب فضائل الصحابة رضى الله تعالى عنهم
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      Good amongst the women are those who ride camels. One of them said: They are pious women of the Quraish, and the other one said: The women of the Quraish are kind to the orphans in their childhood and look after the wealth of their spouses.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا ابن أبي عمر، حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن أبي الزناد، عن الأعرج، عن  أبي هريرة، وعن ابن طاوس، عن أبيه، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ خير نساء ركبن الإبل - قال أحدهما صالح نساء قريش ‏.‏ وقال الآخر نساء قريش - أحناه على يتيم في صغره وأرعاه على زوج في ذات يده ‏"‏ ‏.‏

Did you not know that your Lord is One?' They will reply (saying): "Yes!" Then they were told to follow what was revealed for them; if it had pleased Allah He would have made their hearts united in faith. chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني عمرو الناقد، حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن الزهري، عن أنس بن مالك، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم نهى عن الدباء والمزفت أن ينتبذ فيه ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may Allah be pleased by him) said: A man came to me drinking wine; I ordered that he should stop it until morning but when dawn broke his thirst returned so much in excess of what was lawful [forbidden] for a Muslim, and then the Prophet saw this happening. He asked about himself whether there had been any sin committed against Allah or His Messenger (may peace be upon him). The man said: No! Then he ordered me to drink wine until morning; I did so till dawn broke but when it came my thirst returned in excess of what was lawful [forbidden] for a Muslim. So the Prophet saw this happening and asked about himself whether there had been any sin committed against Allah or His Messenger (may peace be upon him). The man said: No! chapter: The Book of Emancipating Slaves - كتاب العتق
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      The slave who is jointly owned by two persons, and is emancipated by one of them, (this one) has liability (upon him to secure complete freedom for that slave).

chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Excellent Qualities of the Holy Prophet (may Peace be upon them) and His - كتاب الفضائل
ground_truth_en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Khalid with the same chain of transmitters.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا ابن علية، عن خالد، بهذا الإسناد ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabigha bin Al-Ash'ath said: I heard Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) say that whoever is a believer in me as one believes himself to believe will enter Paradise even if he eats only dry bread; but anyone who does so without believing it, his reward shall not go beyond the water which quenches thirst.

chapter: The Book of Prayer (Travellers) - كتاب صلاة المسافرين وقصرها
ground_truth_en: Ibn 'Umar said:                      He who prayed at night should make Witr the end of his prayer, for the Messenger of Allah (way peace be upon him) ordered this.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا هارون بن معروف، وسريج بن يونس، وأبو كريب جميعا عن ابن أبي زائدة، - قال هارون حدثنا ابن أبي زائدة، - أخبرني عاصم الأحول، عن عبد الله بن شقيق، عن ابن عمر، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ بادروا الصبح بالوتر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: I heard Abu Hurairah saying that Messenger of God(Sallalahu Alayhi Wasalam )said:"When a person prays Fajr while he is travelling , then his prayer will remain valid till Dhuhr . And when the time for Asr arrives, it becomes obligatory upon every Muslim to pray as-Shoora (the afternoon Prayer) ."

chapter: The Book of Menstruation - كتاب الحيض
ground_truth_en: This hadith is narrated by Abu Kuraib. Ibn Numair and others, all on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters, but in their narration these words are not there:                     " washed his feet."
ground_truth_ar: وحدثناه قتيبة بن سعيد، وزهير بن حرب، قالا حدثنا جرير، ح وحدثنا علي بن حجر، حدثنا علي بن مسهر، ح وحدثنا أبو كريب، حدثنا ابن نمير، كلهم عن هشام، في هذا الإسناد وليس في حديثهم غسل الرجلين ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad PBUH) said: A woman menstruating should be separated from her husband until she has completed three menstrual cycles or a period of purity lasting forty days; if it is less than that then there must have been some bleeding after this, and the blood will not come out in its entirety. chapter: The Book of Sacrifices - كتاب الأضاحى
ground_truth_en: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that Abu Burda slaughtered the animal as a sacrifice before the ('Id) prayer. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) said:                      Offer a substitute for it (since it does not absolve you of the responsibility of sacrifice). Thereupon he said: Allah's Messenger. I have nothing with me but a goat of less than six months. Shu'ba (one of the narrators) said: I think he (al-Bara' b. 'Azib also) said: And it is better than a goat of one year. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) said: Make it a substitute for that (and sacrifice it), but it will not suffice for anyone (as a sacrifice) after you.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن بشار، حدثنا محمد، - يعني ابن جعفر - حدثنا شعبة، عن سلمة، عن أبي جحيفة، عن البراء بن عازب، قال ذبح أبو بردة قبل الصلاة فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أبدلها ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقال يا رسول الله ليس عندي إلا جذعة - قال شعبة وأظنه قال - وهي خير من مسنة ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اجعلها مكانها ولن تجزي عن أحد بعدك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased) said: I was ordered to perform Hajj when he came from Mecca; so we went with him until Medina where his mother died in my presence while performing Tawaf around her grave on Eid al-Adha, and then she passed away after that. So the Prophet performed Salat for three days over this matter as if it were a funeral prayer (Salatul Janayzah).

chapter: The Book of Menstruation - كتاب الحيض
ground_truth_en: 'A'isha reported:                      The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) said to me: Get me the mat from the mosque. I said: I am menstruating. Upon this he remarked: Your menstruation is not in your hand.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، وأبو بكر بن أبي شيبة وأبو كريب قال يحيى أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن الأعمش، عن ثابت بن عبيد، عن القاسم بن محمد، عن عائشة، قالت قال لي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ناوليني الخمرة من المسجد ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالت فقلت إني حائض ‏.‏ فقال ‏"‏ إن حيضتك ليست في يدك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad PBUH) said: A woman menstruating should neither fast nor pray; if she prays without realizing it then her prayer is invalidated by its imperfection [i.e., missing a rak'ahs]. If, however Allah wishes for the best of His slaves and He desires that they perform prayers in spite thereof (during their menstrual period), let them do so. But whoever fasts during menstruation will have his fasting rejected; but if he prays without realizing it then there is no sin upon him nor punishment on Him [i.e., Allah].

chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Oath; for Establishing the Responsibility of Murders; Fighting; Requital - كتاب القسامة والمحاربين والقصاص والديات
ground_truth_en: Anas b. Malik reported:                      There came to Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) eight persons from the tribe of 'Ukl, but with this addition that he did not cauterise (the wounds which hid been inflicted upon them while punishing them).
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا الحسن بن أبي شعيب الحراني، حدثنا مسكين، - وهو ابن بكير الحراني - أخبرنا الأوزاعي، ح وحدثنا عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن الدارمي، أخبرنا محمد بن يوسف، عن الأوزاعي، عن يحيى بن أبي كثير، عن أبي قلابة، عن أنس بن مالك، قال قدم على رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ثمانية نفر من عكل ‏.‏ بنحو حديثهم ‏.‏ وزاد في الحديث ولم يحسمهم ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: A man came to me asking permission from Me as regards a woman who was pregnant with his child; I gave it [permission] on condition that he should swear an oath concerning her pregnancy before she became delivered of birth and after delivery. Narrated Abu Hurairah

chapter: The Book Pertaining to Clothes and Decoration - كتاب اللباس والزينة
ground_truth_en: A hadith like this has been reported on the authority of Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عقبة بن مكرم العمي، حدثنا أبو عاصم، عن ابن جريج، بهذا الإسناد مثله‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: A woman asked Allah's Messenger about a piece of clothing that was torn in two places; he replied to her saying "Tie it up with your hair." Narrated by Muslim from Al-Bukhari and Ibn Majah, who both narrated this Hadith.

chapter: The Book of Virtue; Good Manners and Joining of the Ties of Relationship - كتاب البر والصلة والآداب
ground_truth_en: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters and no mention is made in the hadith transmitted on the authority of 'Isa (of these words):                     " He who endeavours to tell the truth and endeavours to tell a lie," and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Mushir (the words are):" Until Allah records it".
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا منجاب بن الحارث التميمي، أخبرنا ابن مسهر، ح وحدثنا إسحاق بن، إبراهيم الحنظلي أخبرنا عيسى بن يونس، كلاهما عن الأعمش، بهذا الإسناد ‏.‏ ولم يذكر في حديث عيسى ‏"‏ ويتحرى الصدق ويتحرى الكذب ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وفي حديث ابن مسهر ‏"‏ حتى يكتبه الله ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: “The best of deeds is to speak a good word.” Narrated Abu Hurairah; he used sometimes two or three words at once when speaking well-mannered speech with people in his presence, and then they would say that the Prophet had praised them.

chapter: The Book of Jihad and Expedition - كتاب الجهاد والسير
ground_truth_en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah who said:                      On the day he returned from the Battle of Ahzab, the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) made for us an announcement that nobody would say his Zuhr prayer but in the quarters of Banu Quraiza (Some) people, being afraid that the time for prayer would expire, said their prayers before reaching the street of Banu Quraiza. The others said: We will not say our prayer except where the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) has ordered us to say it even if the time expires. When he learned of the difference in the view of the two groups of the people, the Messenger of Allah (may peace be tipon him) did not blame anyone from the two groups.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني عبد الله بن محمد بن أسماء الضبعي، حدثنا جويرية بن أسماء، عن نافع، عن عبد الله، قال نادى فينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يوم انصرف عن الأحزاب ‏"‏ أن لا يصلين أحد الظهر إلا في بني قريظة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فتخوف ناس فوت الوقت فصلوا دون بني قريظة ‏.‏ وقال آخرون لا نصلي إلا حيث أمرنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وإن فاتنا الوقت قال فما عنف واحدا من الفريقين ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: I was ordered to go out in Jihad with Allah's permission; then he sent me back twice more until it became obligatory on every Muslim who had sufficient means of livelihood that they should fight for Islam and its Prophet, even though their lives were dearer than the life.

chapter: The Book of Masaaqah - كتاب المساقاة
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira (Allah be pleased with him) reported:                      There came a person demanding a camel from Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him). He (the Holy Prophet) said: Give him (the camel) of that age or of more mature age, and said: Best among you is one who is best in clearing off the debt.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير، حدثنا أبي، حدثنا سفيان، عن سلمة بن كهيل، عن أبي سلمة، عن أبي هريرة، قال جاء رجل يتقاضى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بعيرا فقال ‏"‏ أعطوه سنا فوق سنه - وقال - خيركم أحسنكم قضاء ‏"‏ ‏.
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: I was ordered to pray Salat al-Fajr at night when it is still dark in wintertime; so Allah commanded me that my prayer should be shortened by one Rak'aat until he ordained for us a fixed time of Salah, which we have not changed.

chapter: The Book of Masaaqah - كتاب المساقاة
ground_truth_en: Jabir (Allah be pleased with him) reported:                      There came a slave and pledg- ed allegiance to Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) on migration; he (the Holy Prophet) did not know that he was a slave. Then there came his master and demanded him back, whereupon Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) said: Sell him to me. And he bought him for two black slaves, and he did not afterwards take allegiance from anyone until he had asked him whether he was a slave (or a free man)
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يحيى بن يحيى التميمي، وابن، رمح قالا أخبرنا الليث، ح وحدثنيه قتيبة، بن سعيد حدثنا ليث، عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر، قال جاء عبد فبايع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم على الهجرة ولم يشعر أنه عبد فجاء سيده يريده فقال له النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بعنيه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فاشتراه بعبدين أسودين ثم لم يبايع أحدا بعد حتى يسأله ‏"‏ أعبد هو ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: I was ordered to go out as a messenger of Allah with no authority except that which He gave me; then my Lord sent down upon us His Book in Arabic so we would know it well if anyone knew, and whoever knows this book will have his reward doubled.

chapter: The Book of Prayer (Travellers) - كتاب صلاة المسافرين وقصرها
ground_truth_en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:                      The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) bought a camel from me. When he came back to Medina, he ordered me to come to the mosque and observed two rak'ahs of prayer.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبيد الله بن معاذ، حدثنا أبي، حدثنا شعبة، عن محارب، سمع جابر بن عبد الله، يقول اشترى مني رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بعيرا فلما قدم المدينة أمرني أن آتي المسجد فأصلي ركعتين ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah said: The prayer of a traveller is two Rak'ahs (prayers). If he has to travel further than that distance then his second rak'a becomes one raka'. And if there are three places between him where people pray they should be prayed for as well, and the person praying them must not leave until after their prayers.

chapter: The Book Pertaining to Clothes and Decoration - كتاب اللباس والزينة
ground_truth_en: Shu'ba reported from al-Hakam that he heard 'Abd al-Rahmin (i. e. Ibn Abu Laila) as saying:                      I personally saw Hudhaifa asking for water in Mada'in and a man giving it to him in a silver vessel. The rest of the hadith is the same.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا عبيد الله بن معاذ العنبري، حدثنا أبي، حدثنا شعبة، عن الحكم، أنه سمع عبد الرحمن، - يعني ابن أبي ليلى - قال شهدت حذيفة استسقى بالمدائن فأتاه إنسان بإناء من فضة ‏.‏ فذكره بمعنى حديث ابن عكيم عن حذيفة ‏.‏

chapter: The Book of Prayer (Travellers) - كتاب صلاة المسافرين وقصرها
ground_truth_en: Abdullah b. Mughaffal reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) u saying:                      There Is between the two calls (Adhan and Iqama) a prayer. And he mentioned it three times, and at the third time he said: This applies to those who wish to do it.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا شيبان بن فروخ، حدثنا عبد الوارث، عن عبد العزيز، - وهو ابن صهيب - عن أنس بن مالك، قال كنا بالمدينة فإذا أذن المؤذن لصلاة المغرب ابتدروا السواري فيركعون ركعتين ركعتين حتى إن الرجل الغريب ليدخل المسجد فيحسب أن الصلاة قد صليت من كثرة من يصليهما ‏.‏
llm_response:
Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: “When a person is travelling he should pray two rak'ahs in one sitting.” Then Abu Hurairah reported that Allah's Messenger [peacebe unto Him] prayed with his companions after they had finished praying their morning prayer, and then the Prophet stood up for some time. He sat down again to perform another prostration (ruku') of rakat al-Fajr as a parting rak'ahs in one sitting; so he did not pray two consecutive units until this was done.
Narrated Abu Hurairah

chapter: The Book of Oaths - كتاب الأيمان
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      In case the slave is owned by two persons, and one of them emancipates him, he will guarantee (his full freedom).
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا محمد بن المثنى، ومحمد بن بشار، - واللفظ لابن المثنى - قالا حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، حدثنا شعبة، عن قتادة، عن النضر بن أنس، عن بشير بن نهيك، عن أبي، هريرة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال في المملوك بين الرجلين فيعتق أحدهما قال ‏"‏ يضمن ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: I swear to God that if he should say anything good of me or bad from my tongue then it is a lie on his part; but whatever comes out as truth about himself will come forth in accordance with what has been revealed concerning myself. And whoever swears falsely for the sake thereof, Allah shall not forgive him nor have mercy upon such one until death takes away that person and he dies while still lying to people or speaking falsehoods against them (may God curse those who lie).

chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Excellent Qualities of the Holy Prophet (may Peace be upon them) and His - كتاب الفضائل
ground_truth_en: The hadith has been narrated on the authority ot al-A'mash with the same chain of transmitters but no mention is made of:                     " They are my companions; they are my companions."
ground_truth_ar: وحدثناه عثمان بن أبي شيبة، وإسحاق بن إبراهيم، عن جرير، عن الأعمش، بهذا الإسناد ‏.‏ ولم يذكر ‏"‏ أصحابي أصحابي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabigha bin Al-Ash'ath said: I saw Allah's Apostle (may Peace be upon him) sitting with a man who was blind in his right eye; he asked about it saying that there is no harm to me if you cure my blindness, but when the Prophet had cured this man's eyesight and made both of them see clearly then they went away. The next day I saw Allah's Apostle (may Peace be upon him) sitting with a man who was blind in his left eye; he asked about it saying that there is no harm to me if you cure my blindness, but when the Prophet had cured this man's eyesight and made both of them see clearly then they went away. The next day I saw Allah's Apostle (may Peace be upon him) sitting with a man who was blind in his left eye; he asked about it saying that there is no harm to me if you cure my blindness, but when the Prophet had cured this man's eyesight and made both of them see clearly then they went away. The next day I saw Allah's Apostle (may Peace be upon him) sitting with a man who was blind in his left eye; he asked about it saying that there is no harm to me if you cure my blindness, but when the Prophet had cured this man's eyesight and made both of them see clearly then they went away. chapter: The Book of Masaaqah - كتاب المساقاة
ground_truth_en: Abu Qatada al-Ansari (Allah be pleased with him) reported he heard Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) say:                      Beware of swearing; it produces a ready sale for a commodity, but blots out the blessing.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وأبو كريب وإسحاق بن إبراهيم - واللفظ لابن أبي شيبة - قال إسحاق أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا أبو أسامة، عن الوليد بن كثير، عن معبد بن كعب بن مالك، عن أبي قتادة الأنصاري، أنه سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ إياكم وكثرة الحلف في البيع فإنه ينفق ثم يمحق ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: I was ordered to go out in search of people who would believe me; so when Allah sent down His Book with Me as a proof against them He also gave us knowledge about it that we should explain its meaning and make clear the hidden things therein. And if they refused, then let Us send Our Messengers after you until there comes unto mankind such belief in My Unity (Islam) which shall be accepted of none save Him Who is with Me as a Witness against them; He will say: 'Indeed I have been faithful to my promise.' Then We would turn away from those who do not believe. And if they should repent and ask forgiveness for themselves, then surely Our Mercy encompasses all things (i.e., Allah).

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: Ibn 'Umar (Allah be pleased with both of them) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      The month may consist of twenty-nine nights. So do not fast till you have sighted it (the new moon) and do not break it till you have sighted it, except when the sky is cloudy for you, and if it is so, then calculate it.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، ويحيى بن أيوب، وقتيبة بن سعيد، وابن، حجر قال يحيى بن يحيى أخبرنا وقال الآخرون، حدثنا إسماعيل، - وهو ابن جعفر - عن عبد الله بن، دينار أنه سمع ابن عمر، - رضى الله عنهما - قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الشهر تسع وعشرون ليلة لا تصوموا حتى تروه ولا تفطروا حتى تروه إلا أن يغم عليكم فإن غم عليكم فاقدروا له ‏"‏‏.‏

chapter: The Book of Menstruation - كتاب الحيض
ground_truth_en: 'A'isha reported:                      The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) washed himself with water from a vessel (measuring seven to eight seers) because of sexual intercourse.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، قال قرأت على مالك عن ابن شهاب، عن عروة بن الزبير، عن عائشة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يغتسل من إناء هو الفرق من الجنابة ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad PBUH) said: A woman menstruating is prohibited from touching Allah's Book; she must be purified before performing Tawaf or Sa'i in Hajj." Narrated Abu Hurairah RA by al-Bukhari and Muslim, Hadith 319.

chapter: The Book of Prayers - كتاب الصلاة
ground_truth_en: Jabir b. Samura reported:                      The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) came to us and said: How is it that I see you lifting your hands like the tails of headstrong horses? Be calm in prayer. He (the narrator) said: He then again came to us and saw us (sitting) in circles; he said: How is it that I see you in separate groups? He (the narrator) said: He again came to us and said: Why don't you draw yourselves up in rows as angels do in the presence of their Lord? We said: Messenger of Allah, bow do the angels draw themselves up in rows in the presence of their Lord? He (the Holy Prophet) said: They make the first rows complete and keep close together in the row.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وأبو كريب قالا حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن الأعمش، عن المسيب بن رافع، عن تميم بن طرفة، عن جابر بن سمرة، قال خرج علينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال ‏"‏ ما لي أراكم رافعي أيديكم كأنها أذناب خيل شمس اسكنوا في الصلاة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال ثم خرج علينا فرآنا حلقا فقال ‏"‏ ما لي أراكم عزين ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال ثم خرج علينا فقال ‏"‏ ألا تصفون كما تصف الملائكة عند ربها ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقلنا يا رسول الله وكيف تصف الملائكة عند ربها قال ‏"‏ يتمون الصفوف الأول ويتراصون في الصف ‏"‏ ‏.‏

chapter: The Book Pertaining to Clothes and Decoration - كتاب اللباس والزينة
ground_truth_en: Abu Bashir Ansari reported that he had had (the opportunity of accompanying Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) in some of his journeys. Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) sent one of his messengers 'Abdullah b Abi Bakr said:                      I think he said (these words) when the people were at the places of rest: No necklace of strings be left on the necks of the camels or the necklace kept unbroken. Imam Malik said: To my mind (this practice) of wearing necklace round the necks of camels or animals was because of the fact that they (wanted to save them) from the influence of the evil eye.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، قال قرأت على مالك عن عبد الله بن أبي بكر، عن عباد، بن تميم أن أبا بشير الأنصاري، أخبره أنه، كان مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في بعض أسفاره - قال - فأرسل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم رسولا - قال عبد الله بن أبي بكر حسبت أنه قال والناس في مبيتهم - ‏"‏ لا يبقين في رقبة بعير قلادة من وتر أو قلادة إلا قطعت ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال مالك أرى ذلك من العين ‏.‏

ground_truth_en: Ibn Samura al-'Adawi reported:                      I heard Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) say, and he then narrated (the above-mentioned hadith).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن رافع، حدثنا ابن أبي فديك، حدثنا ابن أبي ذئب، عن مهاجر، بن مسمار عن عامر بن سعد، أنه أرسل إلى ابن سمرة العدوي حدثنا ما، سمعت من، رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏.‏ فذكر نحو حديث حاتم ‏.‏

chapter: The Book Pertaining to Piety and Softening of Hearts - كتاب الزهد والرقائق
ground_truth_en: Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakra reported on the authority of his father that a person was mentioned in the presence of Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him), and a person said:                      Allah's Messenger, no person is more excellent than he after Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him). Thereupon Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) said: Woe be to thee, you have broken the neck of your friend, and he said this twice. Then Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) said: If anyone has to praise his brother at all, he should say: I think him to be so and so, and even on this he should say: I do not consider anyone purer than Allah (considers). This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني محمد بن عمرو بن عباد بن جبلة بن أبي رواد، حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، ح وحدثني أبو بكر بن نافع، أخبرنا غندر، قال شعبة حدثنا عن خالد الحذاء، عن عبد، الرحمن بن أبي بكرة عن أبيه، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه ذكر عنده رجل فقال رجل يا رسول الله ما من رجل بعد رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أفضل منه في كذا وكذا ‏.‏ فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ويحك قطعت عنق صاحبك ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مرارا يقول ذلك ثم قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إن كان أحدكم مادحا أخاه لا محالة فليقل أحسب فلانا إن كان يرى أنه كذلك ولا أزكي على الله أحدا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (peace be upon him) said: I heard Allah's Messenger saying that whoever prays Fajr with a straight neck will get it in Paradise; but if he is bent down then his prayer would remain crooked till Judgment Day." Narrated Abu Hurairah, may Allaah have mercy on Him.

chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Merits of the Companions (Allah Be Pleased With Them) of the Holy Prophet - كتاب فضائل الصحابة رضى الله تعالى عنهم
ground_truth_en: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) saw children and women of the Ansar coming back from a wedding feast. Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) stood up motionless (as a mark of respect) and said:                      O Allah, (bear witness) (and addressing the Ansar), said: You are dearest to me amongst people, (and said: O Allah (bear witness) (and addressing the Ansar), said: You are dearest to me amongst people. And he meant Ansar.
ground_truth_ar: حدثني أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وزهير بن حرب، جميعا عن ابن علية، - واللفظ لزهير - حدثنا إسماعيل، عن عبد العزيز، - وهو ابن صهيب - عن أنس، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم رأى صبيانا ونساء مقبلين من عرس فقام نبي الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ممثلا فقال ‏"‏ اللهم أنتم من أحب الناس إلى اللهم أنتم من أحب الناس إلى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يعني الأنصار ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophethood) was sent to every nation; if it did so but they rejected Him then He would change His religion until a people accepted Islam as their faith." Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet said that Allah will send messengers and prophets in all nations, even though some of them reject the Messenger. So I shall keep changing my religious beliefs till one nation accepts me (Islam) or else they are doomed to Hell-fire forever"

chapter: The Book of Prayer (Friday) - كتاب الجمعة
ground_truth_en: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that a person came (in the Mosque) while the Apostle of Allah (may peace be upon him) was delivering the sermon on Friday (standing) on the pulpit. He (the Holy Prophet) said to him:                      Have you offered two rak'ahs? He said: No. Upon this he said: Then observe (them).
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني محمد بن رافع، وعبد بن حميد، قال ابن رافع حدثنا عبد الرزاق، أخبرنا ابن جريج، أخبرني عمرو بن دينار، أنه سمع جابر بن عبد الله، يقول جاء رجل والنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم على المنبر يوم الجمعة يخطب فقال له ‏"‏ أركعت ركعتين ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال
llm_response:
Nabiyyullah (may Allah be pleased by him) said: I was praying in Masjid al-Haram when a man came to me with his hands full of dates; he asked permission from Nabighat bin Harbah who had been sitting next door, and she gave it after asking for the Prophet's consent. chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Excellent Qualities of the Holy Prophet (may Peace be upon them) and His - كتاب الفضائل
ground_truth_en: Rafi' b. Khadij reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) came to Medina and the people had been grafting the trees. He said:                      What are you doing? They said: We are grafting them, whereupon he said: It may perhaps be good for you if you do not do that, so they abandoned this practice (and the date-palms) began to yield less fruit. They made a mention of it (to the Holy Prophet), whereupon he said: I am a human being, so when I command you about a thing pertaining to religion, do accept it, and when I command you about a thing out of my personal opinion, keep it in mind that I am a human being. 'Ikrima reported that he said something like this.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن الرومي اليمامي، وعباس بن عبد العظيم العنبري، وأحمد بن، جعفر المعقري قالوا حدثنا النضر بن محمد، حدثنا عكرمة، - وهو ابن عمار - حدثنا  أبو النجاشي، حدثني رافع بن خديج، قال قدم نبي الله صلى الله عليه وسلم المدينة وهم يأبرون النخل يقولون يلقحون النخل فقال ‏"‏ ما تصنعون ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالوا كنا نصنعه قال ‏"‏ لعلكم لو لم تفعلوا كان خيرا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فتركوه فنفضت أو فنقصت - قال - فذكروا ذلك له فقال ‏"‏ إنما أنا بشر إذا أمرتكم بشىء من دينكم فخذوا به وإذا أمرتكم بشىء من رأى فإنما أنا بشر ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال عكرمة أو نحو هذا ‏.‏ قال المعقري فنفضت ‏.‏ ولم يشك ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: I was sitting in a mosque when Allah's Apostle came to me with his hand on my shoulder saying 'O Abu Hurairah! chapter: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer - كتاب الْمَسَاجِدِ وَمَوَاضِعِ الصَّلاَةِ
ground_truth_en: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abd 'Amr reported:                      'Uthman b. 'Affan (narrated the mosque after evening prayer and sat alone. I also sat alone with him, so he said: 0, son of m brother, I heard tile Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) say: He who observed the 'Isya' prayer in congregation, it was as if he prayed up to the midnight, and he who prayed the morning prayer in congregation, it was as if he prayed the whole night.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، أخبرنا المغيرة بن سلمة المخزومي، حدثنا عبد الواحد، - وهو ابن زياد - حدثنا عثمان بن حكيم، حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن أبي عمرة، قال دخل عثمان بن عفان المسجد بعد صلاة المغرب فقعد وحده فقعدت إليه فقال يا ابن أخي سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ من صلى العشاء في جماعة فكأنما قام نصف الليل ومن صلى الصبح في جماعة فكأنما صلى الليل كله ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: I was ordered to pray in Masjid al-Haram at Mecca; so when Allah's Apostle came out of it he went straight ahead till Al-Safa' Mosque then turned back towards Makkah and prayed there, saying "Subhana Rabbiyal A’zeem" three times.

chapter: The Book of Prayer (Travellers) - كتاب صلاة المسافرين وقصرها
ground_truth_en: Ibn 'Umar reported that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) used to say Nafl prayer on (the back of) his camel in whatever direction it took him.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير، حدثنا أبي، حدثنا عبيد الله، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يصلي سبحته حيثما توجهت به ناقته ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: The prayer of a traveller is two Rak'ahs with Tashahhud in between them; if he cannot find water to wash his hands then it becomes one rak'a only after performing Wudhu and praying as much or less. If there are no stones for sitting, the man should pray standing up on whatever stone-like object can be found (even a piece of broken pottery). And Allah knows best what is right in this matter; whoever prays with sincerity will have his prayer accepted by Him even though he prayed it wrongfully and vice versa: Whoever performs Wudhu correctly then wipes over the same clothes, if there are no stones for sitting or standing up on.

chapter: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer - كتاب الْمَسَاجِدِ وَمَوَاضِعِ الصَّلاَةِ
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported:                      The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) said: When it is a hot day, (delay) the prayer till the extreme heat passes away, for the intensity of heat is from the exhalation of Hell.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني هارون بن سعيد الأيلي، وعمرو بن سواد، وأحمد بن عيسى، قال عمرو أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا ابن وهب، قال أخبرني عمرو، أن بكيرا، حدثه عن بسر بن سعيد، وسلمان الأغر، عن أبي هريرة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ إذا كان اليوم الحار فأبردوا بالصلاة فإن شدة الحر من فيح جهنم ‏"‏ ‏.
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased) said: “The best of my Ummah in terms is that they are those who pray standing.” Narrated Abu Hurairah; he also narrated from Alqama bin Wa'il about Jabir saying "I heard Ibn Abbas say, 'Prayer was performed by the Prophet while sitting.'"

ground_truth_en: Jabir reported that there happened to pass before Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) an ass the face of which had been cauterised, whereupon he said:                      Allah has cursed one who has cauterised it (on the face).
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني سلمة بن شبيب، حدثنا الحسن بن أعين، حدثنا معقل، عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مر عليه حمار قد وسم في وجهه فقال ‏"‏ لعن الله الذي وسمه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased) said: “The best of deeds is to purify one’s self from all that he has no right over.” Narrated Abu Huraira [R.A]. The Prophet Muhammad SAWS was asked about a man who had been given permission by his father, but did not give it. He went and killed him with the intention (of fulfilling) Allah's commandment; so when they came to ask what punishment he would receive for this sin against another person’s life – because no one can kill except God Himself - then Muhammad SAWS said: “He will be punished in Hellfire.” Narrated Abu Huraira [R.A]. The Prophet asked, "Who is the best of you?" They replied that it was a man who had been given permission by his father to marry but did not give him this right. chapter: The Book of Transactions - كتاب البيوع
ground_truth_en: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) having forbidden taking of rent or share of land.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني محمد بن حاتم، حدثنا معلى بن منصور الرازي، حدثنا خالد، أخبرنا الشيباني، عن بكير بن الأخنس، عن عطاء، عن جابر بن عبد الله، قال نهى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أن يؤخذ للأرض أجر أو حظ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased) said: I heard my father saying that whoever sells a slave to his master is selling him twice; once as an owner of slaves in general or else he sold himself first then gave away another person who was under no obligation whatever on behalf and for the sake.
