chapter: The Book of Faith - كتاب الإيمان
ground_truth_en: Muhammad b. Rafi', Abdur-Razzaq, Sufyan, A'mash narrated this hadith like one narrated by Shu'ba, on the authority of Abu Huraira tracing, it (right to the Holy Prophet).
ground_truth_ar: حدثني محمد بن رافع، حدثنا عبد الرزاق، أخبرنا سفيان، عن الأعمش، عن ذكوان، عن أبي هريرة، رفعه قال ‏"‏ لا يزني الزاني ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثم ذكر بمثل حديث شعبة ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may peace be upon him) said: I was ordered to go out as a warner; so when Allah sent me with this mission He also gave Me His permission that whoever asked My help would receive it from Him even though he had committed sins, and if anyone sought refuge in the Lord of mankind then no evil befell them.

chapter: The Book of Faith - كتاب الإيمان
ground_truth_en: It is narrated on the authority of Tariq b. Shihab:                      It was Marwan who initiated (the practice) of delivering khutbah (address) before the prayer on the 'Id day. A man stood up and said: Prayer should precede khutbah. He (Marwan) remarked, This (practice) has been done away with. Upon this Abu Sa'id remarked: This man has performed (his duty) laid on him. I heard the Messenger of Allah as saying: He who amongst you sees something abominable should modify it with the help of his hand; and if he has not strength enough to do it, then he should do it with his tongue, and if he has not strength enough to do it, (even) then he should (abhor it) from his heart, and that is the least of faith.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا وكيع، عن سفيان، ح وحدثنا محمد بن المثنى، حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، حدثنا شعبة، كلاهما عن قيس بن مسلم، عن طارق بن شهاب، - وهذا حديث أبي بكر - قال أول من بدأ بالخطبة يوم العيد قبل الصلاة مروان فقام إليه رجل فقال الصلاة قبل الخطبة ‏.‏ فقال قد ترك ما هنالك ‏.‏ فقال أبو سعيد أما هذا فقد قضى ما عليه سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ من رأى منكم منكرا فليغيره بيده فإن لم يستطع فبلسانه فإن لم يستطع فبقلبه وذلك أضعف الإيمان ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: “Verily God has made it obligatory upon every Muslim to fast during Ramadan.” Narrated Abu Hurairah [RA]. And he added that whoever does so will have his reward doubled for each day of fasting, and if a person dies while still performing the Sunnat then all their sins are forgiven.

chapter: The Book of Oaths - كتاب الأيمان
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      When a slave fulfils obligation of Allah and obligation of his master, he has two rewards for him. I narrated this to Ka'b, and Ka'b said: (Such a slave) has no accountability, nor has a poor believer.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وأبو كريب قالا حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن الأعمش، عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إذا أدى العبد حق الله وحق مواليه كان له أجران ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فحدثتها كعبا فقال كعب ليس عليه حساب ولا على مؤمن مزهد ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: I swear to God that if a man should say unto me 'I am going out on an errand', then he is forbidden from doing so till his return; likewise it would also apply in case of women, and whoever swears thus shall not go forth.

chapter: The Book of Bequests - كتاب الوصية
ground_truth_en: Ibn Sa'd reported his father as saying:                      Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) visited me during my illness. I said: I am willing away the whole of my property. He said: No. I said: Then half? He said: No. I said: Should I will away one-third? He said: Yes, and even one-third is enough.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني القاسم بن زكرياء، حدثنا حسين بن علي، عن زائدة، عن عبد الملك، بن عمير عن مصعب بن سعد، عن أبيه، قال عادني النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقلت أوصي بمالي كله ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ لا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قلت فالنصف ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ لا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقلت أبالثلث فقال ‏"‏ نعم والثلث كثير ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: A man came to me asking permission from his father that he should give a gift of ten dirhams in charity on behalf or as part payment towards fulfilling an obligation imposed upon himself for feeding someone, and I gave it approval; then the same thing happened with another person. So when Allah's Apostle (may peace be placed exclusively over him) heard this news from me about these two men he said: "O people! Do not give gifts in charity as a means of fulfilling an obligation imposed upon you."

chapter: The Book of Games and the Animals which May be Slaughtered and the Aninals that Are to be Eaten - كتاب الصيد والذبائح وما يؤكل من الحيوان
ground_truth_en: Jabir reported:                      Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) sent us (on an expedition) and appointed Abu 'Ubaida our chief that we might intercept a caravan of the Quraish and provided us with a bag of dates. And he found for us nothing besides it. Abu Ubaida gave each of us one date (everyday). I (Abu Zubair, one of the narrators) said: What did you do with that? He said: We sucked that just as a baby sucks and then drank water over that, and it sufficed us for the day until night. We beat off leaves with the help of our staffs, then drenched them with water and ate them. We then went to the coast of the sea, and there rose before us on the coast of the sea something like a big mound. We came near that and we found that it was a beast, called al-'Anbar (spermaceti whale). Abu 'Ubaida said. It is dead. He then said: No (but it does not matter), we have been sent by the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) in the path of Allah and you are hard pressed (on account of the scarcity of food), so you eat that. We three hundred in number stayed there for a month, until we grew bulky. He (Jabir) said: I saw how we extracted pitcher after pitcher full of fat from the cavity of its eye, and sliced from it compact piece of meat equal to a bull or like a bull. Abu 'Ubaida called forth thirteen men from us and he made them sit in the cavity of its eye, and he took hold of one of the ribs of its chest and made it stand and then saddled the biggest of the camels we had with us and it passed under it (the arched rib), and we provided ourselves with pieces of boiled meat (especially for use in our journey). When we came back to Medina, we went to Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: That was a provision which Allah had brought forth for you. Is there any piece of meat (left) with you, so tnat you give to us that? He (Jabir) said: We sent to Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) tome of that (a piece of meat) and he ate it.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثناه يحيى بن يحيى، أخبرنا أبو خيثمة، عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر، قال بعثنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وأمر علينا أبا عبيدة نتلقى عيرا لقريش وزودنا جرابا من تمر لم يجد لنا غيره فكان أبو عبيدة يعطينا تمرة تمرة - قال - فقلت كيف كنتم تصنعون بها قال نمصها كما يمص الصبي ثم نشرب عليها من الماء فتكفينا يومنا إلى الليل وكنا نضرب بعصينا الخبط ثم نبله بالماء فنأكله قال وانطلقنا على ساحل البحر فرفع لنا على ساحل البحر كهيئة الكثيب الضخم فأتيناه فإذا هي دابة تدعى العنبر قال قال أبو عبيدة ميتة ثم قال لا بل نحن رسل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وفي سبيل الله وقد اضطررتم فكلوا قال فأقمنا عليه شهرا ونحن ثلاث مائة حتى سمنا قال ولقد رأيتنا نغترف من وقب عينه بالقلال الدهن ونقتطع منه الفدر كالثور - أو كقدر الثور - فلقد أخذ منا أبو عبيدة ثلاثة عشر رجلا فأقعدهم في وقب عينه وأخذ ضلعا من أضلاعه فأقامها ثم رحل أعظم بعير معنا فمر من تحتها وتزودنا من لحمه وشائق فلما قدمنا المدينة أتينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فذكرنا ذلك له فقال ‏"‏ هو رزق أخرجه الله لكم فهل معكم من لحمه شىء فتطعمونا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فأرسلنا إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم منه فأكله ‏.‏

chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Merits of the Companions (Allah Be Pleased With Them) of the Holy Prophet - كتاب فضائل الصحابة رضى الله تعالى عنهم
ground_truth_en: 'A'isha reported that Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) went out one norning wearing a striped cloak of the black camel's hair that there came Hasan b. 'Ali. He wrapped hitn under it, then came Husain and he wrapped him under it along with the other one (Hasan). Then came Fatima and he took her under it, then came 'Ali and he also took him under it and then said:                      Allah only desires to take away any uncleanliness from you, O people of the household, and purify you (thorough purifying)
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، ومحمد بن عبد الله بن نمير، - واللفظ لأبي بكر - قالا حدثنا محمد بن بشر، عن زكرياء، عن مصعب بن شيبة، عن صفية بنت شيبة، قالت قالت عائشة خرج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم غداة وعليه مرط مرحل من شعر أسود فجاء الحسن بن علي فأدخله ثم جاء الحسين فدخل معه ثم جاءت فاطمة فأدخلها ثم جاء علي فأدخله ثم قال ‏{‏ إنما يريد الله ليذهب عنكم الرجس أهل البيت ويطهركم تطهيرا‏}‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophethood) was sent to every people group in order that they might receive guidance from Allah Ta'ala through His Messenger Sallallahu Alayhi Wasalam; so whoever receives it is guided by Him while those who reject its message are led astray, and the Prophet's mission would not have been completed unless he had succeeded with some of them. Narrated Abu Hurairah (may Allaah be pleased with him)

chapter: The Book Pertaining to Piety and Softening of Hearts - كتاب الزهد والرقائق
ground_truth_en: Iyas b. Salama b. al-Akwa reported that his father reported to him that he heard Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      A person sneezed in his presence and he said to him: May Allah have mercy upon you. And he then sneezed for the second time and Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) said to him: He is suffering from cold (and no response is necessary).
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، - واللفظ له - حدثنا أبو النضر، هاشم بن القاسم حدثنا عكرمة بن عمار، حدثني إياس بن سلمة بن الأكوع، أن أباه، حدثه أنه، سمع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وعطس رجل عنده فقال له ‏"‏ يرحمك الله ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثم عطس أخرى فقال له رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الرجل مزكوم ‏"‏ ‏.‏

chapter: The Book of Gifts - كتاب الهبات
ground_truth_en: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      Life grant is the heritage of one upon whom it is conferred.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يحيى بن حبيب الحارثي، حدثنا خالد، - يعني ابن الحارث - حدثنا سعيد، عن قتادة، عن عطاء، عن جابر، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال ‏"‏ العمرى ميراث لأهلها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: A man came to me asking permission from Allahu ta'ala that he may give a gift in charity on behalf of his father who had died while still alive; so I gave my consent, and when it was time for the giving away [of alms], this person went up before us. He took out two hundred dirhams (coins) which were given to me by him as an inheritance from a deceased man whom he did not know anything about except that his father had died while still alive; so I said: "O Allahu ta'ala! Grant the reward for this gift and forgive my brother's debt." Then, when it was time [for giving away alms], we went up to him. He gave me two hundred dirhams which he took out of his father's inheritance as an heir from a deceased man whom I did not know anything about except that (his father) had died while still alive; so the reward for this gift is given by Allahu ta'ala, and my brother's debt has been forgiven.

chapter: The Book Pertaining to Paradise; Its Description; Its Bounties and Its Intimates - كتاب الجنة وصفة نعيمها وأهلها
ground_truth_en: Jabir reported:                      I heard Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) as saying three days before his death: None of you should court death but only hoping good from Allah
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، أخبرنا يحيى بن زكرياء، عن الأعمش، عن أبي سفيان، عن جابر، قال سمعت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قبل وفاته بثلاث يقول ‏"‏ لا يموتن أحدكم إلا وهو يحسن بالله الظن ‏"‏ ‏.‏

ground_truth_en: Abu Zubair reported that he saw Jabir b. 'Abdullah praying in a single garment crossing Its ends even though he had the garments, and Jabir said:                      He saw the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) doing like this.

chapter: The Book of Jihad and Expedition - كتاب الجهاد والسير
ground_truth_en: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik who said that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) allowed Umm Sulaim and some other women of the Ansar to accompany him when he went to war; they would give water (to the soldiers) and would treat the wounded.

chapter: Introduction - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا سويد بن سعيد، حدثنا علي بن مسهر، قال سمعت أنا وحمزة الزيات، من أبان بن أبي عياش نحوا من ألف حديث ‏.‏ قال علي فلقيت حمزة فأخبرني أنه رأى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في المنام فعرض عليه ما سمع من أبان فما عرف منها إلا شيئا يسيرا خمسة أو ستة ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased to him) said: “The best of my community in this world is he who prays most often.” Narrated Abu Hurairah [May God have mercy on himself] that Aisha was sitting with me when I saw her praying, so she got up and went away. She came back after a while saying (to the Prophet): ‘O Messenger Allah! What did you see?’ He said: “I noticed how much time had passed.” So he asked about it again; then this happened once more until Aisha finally told him that I saw her praying continuously for an hour and she was not even aware of what day or month (it might have been Ramadan) nor the prayer times. The Prophet, may Allah bless his face said: “A woman who prays like you is better than a whole nation.” Narrated Abu Hurairah [may God be pleased with him].

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: Abu Darda' reported:                      We were with the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) on some of his journeys on an intensely hot day so much so that a person would place his hand on his head (in order to protect himself) against excessive heat, and none amongst us was fasting but the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) and Abdullah b. Rawaha
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الله بن مسلمة القعنبي، حدثنا هشام بن سعد، عن عثمان بن حيان، الدمشقي عن أم الدرداء، قالت قال أبو الدرداء لقد رأيتنا مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في بعض أسفاره في يوم شديد الحر حتى إن الرجل ليضع يده على رأسه من شدة الحر وما منا أحد صائم إلا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وعبد الله بن رواحة ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may Allah be pleased by him) said: “The best of fasting is that one does it with sincerity.” And he added to this saying in another narration; "He who eats or drinks while praying fasts has broken his prayer." Narrated Abu Hurairah [RA]. He also narrated from the Prophet Muhammad SAWS (peace be upon Him): 'Whoever prays for rain and then breaks their own fasting, Allah will not send down any water.' And he said: ‘The best of deeds is to pray with sincerity.’

chapter: The Book Pertaining to Punishments Prescribed by Islam - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: Ali reported:                      If I impose Hadd on anyone, and he (in course of punish ment) dies, I would not mind except in case of a drunkard. If he dies. I would pay indemnity for him because the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) has laid down no rule for it.
ground_truth_ar: حدثني محمد بن منهال الضرير، حدثنا يزيد بن زريع، حدثنا سفيان الثوري، عن أبي حصين، عن عمير بن سعيد، عن علي، قال ما كنت أقيم على أحد حدا فيموت فيه فأجد منه في نفسي إلا صاحب الخمر لأنه إن مات وديته لأن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم لم يسنه ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: If a man kills an animal belonging to another person without his permission then he must pay its price as compensation; if it is killed by accident or in self-defence while fighting with someone else, there should not even have been any intention of killing. And whoever has committed adultery and fornication (with women) shall be punished for that crime according the punishment prescribed against them: they may either repent before God Almighty - Allahu Akbar- , which is better; or if he repents after committing it then his repentance will not change what was done, unless there are witnesses who testify to this. If a man commits adultery and fornication with women (and) does so secretly without anyone witnessing the act of intercourse between them but they have been found out by God Almighty - Allahu Akbar- , he should be punished for that crime according its punishment prescribed against him: either repent before Him, which is better; or if there are witnesses who testify to this then his repentance will not change what was done. chapter: The Book of Prayer (Eclipse) - كتاب الكسوف
ground_truth_en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Isma'il with the same chain of transmitters and in the hadith narrated by Sufyan and Waki' (the words are):                     " The sun eclipsed on the day when Ibrahim died, and the people said: It has eclipsed on the death of Ibrahim."
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا وكيع، وأبو أسامة وابن نمير ح وحدثنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، أخبرنا جرير، ووكيع، ح وحدثنا ابن أبي عمر، حدثنا سفيان، ومروان، كلهم عن إسماعيل، بهذا الإسناد ‏.‏ وفي حديث سفيان ووكيع انكسفت الشمس يوم مات إبراهيم فقال الناس انكسفت لموت إبراهيم ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad PBUH) said: I heard Allah's Messenger saying that whoever prays Fajr after its time has missed it completely; he should pray another prayer at night or make up a part of his previous day's fast, and if there is no other option for him then the expiation thereof will be fasting two consecutive months.

chapter: The Book on Salutations and Greetings - كتاب السلام
ground_truth_en: 'A'isha reported:                      Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) used to recite (this supplication) as the words of incantation:" Lord of the people, remove the trouble for in Thine Hand is the cure; none is there to relieve him (the burden of disease) but only Thou.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وأبو كريب - واللفظ لأبي كريب - قالا حدثنا  ابن نمير، حدثنا هشام، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان يرقي بهذه الرقية ‏"‏ أذهب الباس رب الناس بيدك الشفاء لا كاشف له إلا أنت ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: I was sent to every people group in this world with a good greeting; then it became obligatory upon me that whoever saw or met Nabiyyu Muhammad would greet them saying "Peace" ("Salaam") and he who did not say peace, his reward is lost.

chapter: The Book of Pilgrimage - كتاب الحج
ground_truth_en: 'Abdullah b. Zaid b. 'Asim (Allah be pleased with him) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      Verily Ibrahim declared Mecca sacred and supplicated (for blessings to be showered) upon its inhabitants, and I declare Medina to be sacred as lbrahim had declared Mecca to be sacred. I have supplicated (Allah for His blessings to be showered) in its sa' and its mudd (two standards of weight and measurement) twice as did Ibrahim for the inhabitants of Mecca.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد، حدثنا عبد العزيز، - يعني ابن محمد الدراوردي - عن عمرو بن يحيى المازني، عن عباد بن تميم، عن عمه عبد الله بن زيد بن عاصم، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ إن إبراهيم حرم مكة ودعا لأهلها وإني حرمت المدينة كما حرم إبراهيم مكة وإني دعوت في صاعها ومدها بمثلى ما دعا به إبراهيم لأهل مكة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased) said: I was ordered to go on pilgrimage but my father died before me; so when he passed away while in Makkah a man came from Madinah saying that you are going there as well for your father's funeral, and asked if it would not have been better had we gone together. So the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Go along with them to perform Hajj at least once; then return home alone so they may say of me what is good in my saying or bad.
Narrated Abu Huraira [Muslim 160].

chapter: The Book of Pilgrimage - كتاب الحج
ground_truth_en: A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said:                      We proceeded with the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) during the year of the Farewell Pilgrimage. There were those amongst us who had put on Ihram for Umra, and those who had put on Ibrim both for Hajj and" Umra, and those amongst us who had put on Ihram for Hajj (only), while the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) had put on Ihram for Hajj (only). He who put on Ihrim for Umra put it off (after performing Umra), and he who had put on Ihram for Hajj or for both Hajj and 'Umra did not put it off before the day of sacrifice (10th of Dhu'I-Hijja).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يحيى بن يحيى، قال قرأت على مالك عن أبي الأسود، محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن نوفل عن عروة، عن عائشة، - رضى الله عنها - أنها قالت خرجنا مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عام حجة الوداع فمنا من أهل بعمرة ومنا من أهل بحج وعمرة ومنا من أهل بالحج وأهل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بالحج فأما من أهل بعمرة فحل وأما من أهل بحج أو جمع الحج والعمرة فلم يحلوا حتى كان يوم النحر ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: I heard Allah's Messenger saying that whoever performs Tawaf around Safa or Marwa with a single intention will have his sins forgiven except those committed by force of circumstances such as theft during Hajj, adultery and drinking intoxicants. Narrated Abu Hurairah; Muslim

chapter: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer - كتاب الْمَسَاجِدِ وَمَوَاضِعِ الصَّلاَةِ
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported:                      The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) said: He who eats of this plant (garlic) should not approach our mosque and should not harm us with the odour of garlic.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني محمد بن رافع، وعبد بن حميد، قال عبد أخبرنا وقال ابن رافع، حدثنا عبد الرزاق، أخبرنا معمر، عن الزهري، عن ابن المسيب، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ من أكل من هذه الشجرة فلا يقربن مسجدنا ولا يؤذينا بريح الثوم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may Allah be pleased by him) said: “The best of places to pray in is Masjid al-Haram.” Narrated Abu Hurairah [May Allaah have mercy on them]. And he also narrated that Ibn 'Umar reported from his father saying, "I heard the Messenger(sallallaahu alehi was salaam waaleihi wassalam) say: ‘The best of places to pray in is Masjid al-Haram.’" Narrated Abu Huraira.

chapter: The Book Pertaining to Repentance and Exhortation to Repentance - كتاب التوبة
ground_truth_en: Abu Burda reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      There would come people amongst the Muslims on the Day of Resurrection with as heavy sins as a mountain, and Allah would forgive them and He would place in their stead the Jews and the Christians. (As far as I think), Abu Raub said: I do not know as to who is in doubt. Abu Burda said: I narrated it to 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz, whereupon he said: Was it your father who narrated it to you from Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him)? I said: Yes.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عمرو بن عباد بن جبلة بن أبي رواد، حدثنا حرمي بن عمارة، حدثنا شداد أبو طلحة الراسبي، عن غيلان بن جرير، عن أبي بردة، عن أبيه، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ يجيء يوم القيامة ناس من المسلمين بذنوب أمثال الجبال فيغفرها الله لهم ويضعها على اليهود والنصارى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فيما أحسب أنا ‏.‏ قال أبو روح لا أدري ممن الشك ‏.‏ قال أبو بردة فحدثت به عمر بن عبد العزيز فقال أبوك حدثك هذا عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قلت نعم ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: “Verily there is no repentance from Jahannam except that a man should repent to God with his whole heart.” Narrated Abu Hurairah [RA]. And he added saying; "And if you do not find it, then let your hand go out and strike the neck of one who has committed adultery."

chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Rules of Inheritance - كتاب الفرائض
ground_truth_en: Abu Ishaq said that he heard al-Bara' b. 'Azib (Allah be pleased with him) say:                      The last complete sura revealed (in the Holy Qur'an) is Sura Tauba (i e. al-Bara'at, ix.), and the last verse revealed is that pertaining to Kalala.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم الحنظلي، أخبرنا عيسى، - وهو ابن يونس - حدثنا زكرياء، عن أبي إسحاق، عن البراء، أن آخر، سورة أنزلت تامة سورة التوبة وأن آخر آية أنزلت آية الكلالة ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: A woman did me a favor by giving birth to my son; so I asked her about it until she told us that he was born of an unknown man who had died before we knew him." Narrated Abu Huraira, Allah's Messenger passed away and left behind two sons. One is Ali bin Abi Talib (may peace be upon them both) whose father has been mentioned to me as a slave girl; the other son whom I have not seen since my death was born of an unknown man who died before we knew him." Narrated Abu Huraira, Allah's Messenger passed away and left behind two sons. One is Ali bin Abi Talib (may peace be upon them both) whose father has been mentioned to me as a slave girl; the other son whom I have not seen since my death was born of an unknown man who died before we knew him." Narrated Abu Huraira, Allah's Messenger passed away and left behind two sons. One is Ali bin Abi Talib (may peace be upon them both) whose father has been mentioned to me as a slave girl; the other son whom I have not seen since my death was born of an unknown man who died before we knew him." chapter: The Book of Menstruation - كتاب الحيض
ground_truth_en: This hadith is narrated by the same chain of transmitters by Ahmad al. Darimi, Zakariya b. 'Adi, Yazid, i. e. ' Ibn Zurai', Rauh b. al-Qasim, Ayyub b. Musa with the same chain of transmitters, and there is a mention of these words:                     " Should I undo the plait and wash it, because of sexual intercourse?" and there is no mention of menstruation.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنيه أحمد الدارمي، حدثنا زكرياء بن عدي، حدثنا يزيد، - يعني ابن زريع - عن روح بن القاسم، حدثنا أيوب بن موسى، بهذا الإسناد وقال أفأحله فأغسله من الجنابة ‏.‏ ولم يذكر الحيضة ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: A woman menstruating is prohibited from touching Allah's Book; nor should she touch anything that has touched it until its impurity leaves her body by means of a menstrual flow or an emission [of semen]. If there be no such thing, then the prohibition remains. And if one touches something which he knows to have been in contact with menstruating woman and is not sure whether this person was pure when she left off (the period), it will suffice him that Allah has forgiven her for what may or might exist between them; but whoever does so intentionally shall be punished by the Fire, unless his heart repents. Narrated Abu Huraira

chapter: The Book of Prayer (Friday) - كتاب الجمعة
ground_truth_en: Abu Wa'il reported:                      'Ammar delivered to us the sermon. It was short and eloquent. When he (, Ammir) descended (from the pulpit) we said to him: 0 Abd al-Yaqzn, you have delivered a short and eloquent sermon. Would that you had lengthened (the sermon). He said: I have heard the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) as saying: The lengthening of prayer by a man and the shortness of the sermon is the sign of his understanding (of faith). So lengthen the prayer and shorten the sermon, for there is charm (in precise) expression.
ground_truth_ar: حدثني سريج بن يونس، حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن عبد الملك بن أبجر، عن أبيه، عن واصل بن حيان، قال قال أبو وائل خطبنا عمار فأوجز وأبلغ فلما نزل قلنا يا أبا اليقظان لقد أبلغت وأوجزت فلو كنت تنفست ‏.‏ فقال إني سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ إن طول صلاة الرجل وقصر خطبته مئنة من فقهه فأطيلوا الصلاة واقصروا الخطبة وإن من البيان سحرا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased) said: “When a person prays Fajr while he is in his house then it becomes obligatory upon him to go out at sunset; if one prayed Maghrib when sitting down or standing up that prayer will become an obligation for the same time as well. If someone missed Zuhr and Asr prayers, they should pray them together.”

chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Excellent Qualities of the Holy Prophet (may Peace be upon them) and His - كتاب الفضائل
ground_truth_en: Musa b. Talha reported:                      I and Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) happened to pass by people near the date-palm trees. He (the Holy Prophet) said: What are these people doing? They said: They are grafting, i. e. they combine the male with the female (tree) and thus they yield more fruit. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) said: I do not find it to be of any use. The people were informed about it and they abandoned this practice. Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) (was later) on informed (that the yield had dwindled), whereupon he said: If there is any use of it, then they should do it, for it was just a personal opinion of mine, and do not go after my personal opinion; but when I say to you anything on behalf of Allah, then do accept it, for I do not attribute lie to Allah, the Exalted and Glorious.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد الثقفي، وأبو كامل الجحدري - وتقاربا في اللفظ وهذا حديث قتيبة - قالا حدثنا أبو عوانة عن سماك عن موسى بن طلحة عن أبيه قال مررت مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بقوم على رءوس النخل فقال ‏"‏ ما يصنع هؤلاء ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقالوا يلقحونه يجعلون الذكر في الأنثى فيلقح ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ما أظن يغني ذلك شيئا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال فأخبروا بذلك فتركوه فأخبر رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم بذلك فقال ‏"‏ إن كان ينفعهم ذلك فليصنعوه فإني إنما ظننت ظنا فلا تؤاخذوني بالظن ولكن إذا حدثتكم عن الله شيئا فخذوا به فإني لن أكذب على الله عز وجل ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: I was sitting in a mosque when Abu Bakr came to me with his hands full of dates; he asked if there were any hungry people among us who could eat them so that Allah might give blessings on this charity and the Prophet would say, "No." Then they went out. A while later someone else brought some food for sale but it was not sold because Abu Bakr said to me: 'O Messenger of God! Do you know what is better than selling something? Selling a person from his family.' So I asked him who this man or woman would be, and he replied that the Prophet (may peace always remain with Him) had told us about it. Then we went out again; Abu Bakr came to me saying: 'O Messenger of God! Do you know what is better than selling something? Selling a person from his family.' I asked him who this man or woman would be, and he replied that the Prophet (may peace always remain with Him) had told us about it. Then we went out again; Abu Bakr came to me saying: 'O Messenger of God! Do you know what is better than selling something? Selling a person from his family.' I asked him who this man or woman would be, and he replied that the Prophet (may peace always remain with Him) had told us about it. Then we went out again; Abu Bakr came to me saying: 'O

chapter: The Book of Masaaqah - كتاب المساقاة
ground_truth_en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Bukair b. al-Ashajj with the same chain of transmitters.
ground_truth_ar: حدثني يونس بن عبد الأعلى، أخبرنا عبد الله بن وهب، أخبرني عمرو بن الحارث، عن بكير بن الأشج، بهذا الإسناد مثله ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: I was ordered to pray Salat al-Fajr before sunrise but when it came time my wife would say 'Rise up!' so that is what we did until Allah revealed Suratul Fajar [Chapter 96] which states, "When the Adhha'a rises over you from behind them (the unbelievers) they cry out with voices like those who are in fear of no one. So rise before it comes to pass and pray on your feet; surely this is a reminder for mankind."

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) was presented two cups at Bait al-Maqdis on the night of Heavenly Journey, one containing wine and the other containing milk. He looked at both of them, and be took the one containing milk, whereupon Gabriel (peace be upon him) said:                      Praise is due to Allah Who guided you to the true nature; had you taken the one containing wine, Your Umma would have gone astray.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن عباد، وزهير بن حرب، - واللفظ لابن عباد - قالا حدثنا أبو صفوان أخبرنا يونس، عن الزهري، قال قال ابن المسيب قال أبو هريرة إن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أتي ليلة أسري به بإيلياء بقدحين من خمر ولبن فنظر إليهما فأخذ اللبن ‏.‏ فقال له جبريل عليه السلام الحمد لله الذي هداك للفطرة لو أخذت الخمر غوت أمتك ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: There is no drink that Allah has forbidden except Khamr [intoxicating liquor]. And there are none of its effects better than those which come from Khamsah al-Khameer, i.e., the seven springs in Paradise. Narrated Abu Hurairah May God have mercy on himself (may peace be upon him).

chapter: The Book of Zakat - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported that the Prophet (may peace be upon him) said:                      Nothing is more delighting to me than this that Uhud should be of gold for me, and no dinar is left with me out of it before three nights pass except a dinar which I would set aside for the repayment of debt upon me.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن سلام الجمحي، حدثنا الربيع، - يعني ابن مسلم - عن محمد بن زياد، عن أبي هريرة، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ ما يسرني أن لي أحدا ذهبا تأتي على ثالثة وعندي منه دينار إلا دينار أرصده لدين على ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah Muhammad (peace be upon him) said: Zakat is a duty on every Muslim who has sufficient means to meet his needs; it includes all things that are acquired by trade or commerce until they reach their final stage of consumption as food, drink and clothing for oneself in the present year. If there remains any surplus after this expenditure then one fifth (2/5) should be given away according unto Allah's commandment upon those who have no means to meet needs; but if he has not sufficient resources even though it is a small amount of money or goods, let him pray for its increase and give what little may remain as charity. And whoever does this will receive double reward from his Lord in the Hereafter (Sunan Abu Dawud 1:14-15).

chapter: The Book of Jihad and Expedition - كتاب الجهاد والسير
ground_truth_en: It has been reported on the authority of Abu Hazim who heard from Sahl b. Sa'd. The latter was asked about the injury of the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him). He said:                      By God, I know the person who washed the wound of the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him), who poured water on it and with what the wound was treated. Then Sahl narrated the same tradition as has been narrated by 'Abd al-'Azlz except that he added the words:" And his face was injured" and replaced the word" Hushimat" by" Kusirat" (i. e. it was broken).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد، حدثنا يعقوب، - يعني ابن عبد الرحمن القاري - عن أبي حازم، أنه سمع سهل بن سعد، وهو يسأل عن جرح، رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال أم والله إني لأعرف من كان يغسل جرح رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ومن كان يسكب الماء ‏.‏ وبماذا دووي جرحه ‏.‏ ثم ذكر نحو حديث عبد العزيز غير أنه زاد وجرح وجهه وقال مكان هشمت كسرت ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: I was ordered to go out in Jihad with Allah's permission; so when my father died he left me a debt of forty thousand dirhams which is equal approximately 4 million dollars, and it took ten years for the whole amount. So after that time had passed on one day (the Prophet Muhammad) came down from Mount Safa to Mecca in order I might go out with him; so when we went up into Masjid al-Haram he said: O Allah! Bless us as you blessed Abraham and Ishmael, our father who built this mosque. And grant me success like the one that was granted unto them both (Abraham & Ismail). So after his prayer had finished I asked permission to go out with him; so when we went up into Masjid al-Haram he said: O Allah! Bless us as you blessed Abraham and Ishmael, our father who built this mosque. And grant me success like the one that was granted unto them both (Abraham & Ismail). chapter: The Book Pertaining to Clothes and Decoration - كتاب اللباس والزينة
ground_truth_en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira but with a different chain of transmitters.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا عبيد الله بن معاذ، حدثنا أبي ح، وحدثنا محمد بن بشار، عن محمد بن،جعفر ح وحدثنا محمد بن المثنى، حدثنا ابن أبي عدي، قالوا جميعا حدثنا شعبة، عن محمد بن زياد، عن أبي هريرة، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم بنحو هذا ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: I was ordered to fast during Ramadhan but my wife prevented me from doing so; she took a piece of bread out in front [of] him when he went outside on his journey home for lunch, and gave it into the hands that were holding up her face. She then told them not eat anything until they had finished eating their meal with Nabiyyah (peace be upon Him). So I said: O Allah! chapter: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer - كتاب الْمَسَاجِدِ وَمَوَاضِعِ الصَّلاَةِ
ground_truth_en: Anas b. Malik reported:                      The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) said: When any one of you is engaged in prayer, he is holding intimate conversation with his Lord, so none of you must spit in front of him, or towards his right side, but towards his left side under his foot.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن المثنى، وابن، بشار قال ابن المثنى حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، حدثنا شعبة، قال سمعت قتادة، يحدث عن أنس بن مالك، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إذا كان أحدكم في الصلاة فإنه يناجي ربه فلا يبزقن بين يديه ولا عن يمينه ولكن عن شماله تحت قدمه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: There is no prayer in a mosque except that it should contain water or its equivalent; if there are neither of them then one must pray at home as much he can afford to go out for prayers, and whoever cannot do so will have his reward.

chapter: The Book of Prayer (Travellers) - كتاب صلاة المسافرين وقصرها
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      Allah has not heard anything (more pleasing) than listening to the Prophet reciting the Qur'an in a sweet loud voice.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني ابن أخي ابن وهب، حدثنا عمي عبد الله بن وهب، أخبرني عمر بن، مالك وحيوة بن شريح عن ابن الهاد، بهذا الإسناد ‏.‏ مثله سواء وقال إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ ولم يقل سمع ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: “When a person travels from one land to another he should pray two rak'ahs at night.” Narrated Abu Hurairah [May Allah have mercy on his soul] that when Messenger of Allahthe Prophet Muhammad Sallallahu Alayhi Wasalam was asked about prayer for travellers, the hadith content is: "When a person travels from one land to another he should pray two rak'ahs at night."

chapter: The Book of Pilgrimage - كتاب الحج
ground_truth_en: Salim narrated on the authority of his father (Allah be pleased with him) that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) entered the House along with Usama b. Zaid, Bilal and Uthman b. Talha. They closed the door from within, and, as they opened it, I was the first to get into it and meet Bilal, and I asked him:                      Did Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) observe prayer in it? He said: Yes, he observed prayer between these two Yemenite pillars (pillars situated towards the side of Yemen).
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد، حدثنا ليث، ح وحدثنا ابن رمح، أخبرنا الليث، عن ابن، شهاب عن سالم، عن أبيه، أنه قال دخل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم البيت هو وأسامة بن زيد وبلال وعثمان بن طلحة فأغلقوا عليهم فلما فتحوا كنت في أول من ولج فلقيت بلالا فسألته هل صلى فيه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال نعم صلى بين العمودين اليمانيين.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: I was ordered to go out as a Mujahid [one who strives in God's path] with my brother Abu Hurairah until we reached Al-Hira'. Then he sent me back saying, 'Go and do not return.' So when the Prophet saw us returning from that journey (to Mecca), He asked about it. We said: You ordered Us to go out as Mujahidun [striving in God's path] with Abu Hurairah until we reached Al-Hira'. Then you sent me back saying, 'Go and do not return.' So when the Prophet saw us returning from that journey (to Mecca), He asked about it. We said: You ordered Us to go out as Mujahidun [striving in God's path] with Abu Hurairah until we reached Al-Hira'. Then you sent me back saying, 'Go and do not return.' So when the Prophet saw us returning from that journey (to Mecca), He asked about it. We said: You ordered Us to go out as Mujahidun [striving in God's path] with Abu Hurairah until we reached Al-Hira'. Then you sent me back saying, 'Go and do not return.' So when the Prophet saw us returning from that journey (to Mecca), He asked about it. We said: You ordered Us to go out as Mujahidun [striving in God's path] with Abu Hur

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: 'Imran b. Husain (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) having said to him or to someone else:                      Did you fast in the middle of Sha'ban? He said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: If you did not observe fast, then you should observe fast for two days.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا هداب بن خالد، حدثنا حماد بن سلمة، عن ثابت، عن مطرف، - ولم أفهم مطرفا من هداب - عن عمران بن حصين، - رضى الله عنهما - أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال له أو لآخر ‏"‏ أصمت من سرر شعبان ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال لا ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ فإذا أفطرت فصم يومين ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased) said: “I fasted Ramadan in Makkah; I did so until my hair turned white.” Narrated Abu Hurairah [RA]. And he continued fasting till his beard became greyish-white as well, and then they used to say about him that the Prophet Muhammad PBUH was like a tree whose leaves were green.

chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah; Supplication; Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness - كتاب الذكر والدعاء والتوبة والاستغفار
ground_truth_en: Abu Musa reported:                      We were along with Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) on a journey when the people began to pronounce Allah-o-Akbar in a loud voice. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) said: O people, sh mercy to yourselves for you are not calling One Who is deaf or absent. Verily, you are calling One Who is All-Hearing (and) Near to you and is with you. Abu Musa told that he had been behind him (the Holy Prophet) and reciting:" There is neither might nor power but that of Allah." He (the Holy Prophet), while addressing 'Abdullah b. Qais, said: Should I not direct you to a treasure from amongst the treasurers of Para- dise? I ('Abdullah b. Qais) said: Allah's Messenger, do it, of course. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Then recite:" There is no might and no power but that of Allah."
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا محمد بن فضيل، وأبو معاوية عن عاصم، عن أبي عثمان، عن أبي موسى، قال كنا مع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم في سفر فجعل الناس يجهرون بالتكبير فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أيها الناس اربعوا على أنفسكم إنكم ليس تدعون أصم ولا غائبا إنكم تدعون سميعا قريبا وهو معكم ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال وأنا خلفه وأنا أقول لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله فقال ‏"‏ يا عبد الله بن قيس ألا أدلك على كنز من كنوز الجنة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقلت بلى يا رسول الله ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ قل لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله ‏"‏ ‏.‏

Grant this servant of Mine forgiveness as You have forgiven Me; grant Him a reward in Paradise equal with mine and do not make his punishment worse than what you made it. Then the man comes behind him, but he is blind (and cannot see). chapter: The Book of Luqatah - كتاب اللقطة
ground_truth_en: Zaid b. Khalid al-Juhani reported that a person asked Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) about picking up of stray articles, whereupon he said:                      Make announcement about it for a year, and recognise well the strap and the bag (containing that) ; then spend that; and if its owner comes, make him the payment of that. He (the inquirer) said: Messenger of Allah, what about the lost goat? he said: Take it, for that is yours or for your brother, or for the wolf. He (again) said: (What about) the lost camel? The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) was enraged until his cheeks became red (or his face became red) and then said: You have nothing to do about that; it has feet and a leather bag (to quench its thirst) until its owner finds it.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا يحيى بن أيوب، وقتيبة، وابن، حجر قال ابن حجر أخبرنا وقال الآخران، حدثنا إسماعيل، - وهو ابن جعفر - عن ربيعة بن أبي عبد الرحمن، عن يزيد، مولى المنبعث عن زيد بن خالد الجهني، أن رجلا، سأل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن اللقطة فقال ‏"‏ عرفها سنة ثم اعرف وكاءها وعفاصها ثم استنفق بها فإن جاء ربها فأدها إليه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقال يا رسول الله فضالة الغنم قال ‏"‏ خذها فإنما هي لك أو لأخيك أو للذئب ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقال يا رسول الله فضالة الإبل قال فغضب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم حتى احمرت وجنتاه - أو احمر وجهه - ثم قال ‏"‏ ما لك ولها معها حذاؤها وسقاؤها حتى يلقاها ربها ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: A woman came to me carrying a bag of gold which she found in her house; I ordered that it should remain with its owner until he returned from his journey or died there without finding anyone who owned this property, and then the Prophet Muhammad SAWS would give orders about what was best for such cases.

chapter: The Book of Jihad and Expedition - كتاب الجهاد والسير
ground_truth_en: A hadith has been narrated by Mus'ab b. Sa'd who heard it from his father as saying:                      My father took a sword from Khums and brought it to the Holy Prophet (may peace be upon him) and said: Grant it to me. He refused. At this Allah revealed (the Qur'anic verse):" They ask thee concerning the spoils of war. Say: The spoils of war are for Allah and the Apostle" (viii. 1).
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد، حدثنا أبو عوانة، عن سماك، عن مصعب بن سعد، عن أبيه، قال أخذ أبي من الخمس سيفا فأتى به النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال هب لي هذا ‏.‏ فأبى فأنزل الله عز وجل ‏{‏ يسألونك عن الأنفال قل الأنفال لله والرسول‏}‏

chapter: The Book of Suckling - كتاب الرضاع
ground_truth_en: Umm Salama said to 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her):                      A young boy who is at the threshold of puberty comes to you. I, however, do not like that he should come to me, whereupon 'A'isha (Allah be pleased with her) said: Don't you see in Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) a model for you? She also said: The wife of Abu Hudhaifa said: Messenger of Allah, Salim comes to me and now he is a (grown-up) person, and there is something that (rankles) in the mind of Abu Hudhaifa about him, whereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) said: Suckle him (so that he may become your foster-child), and thus he may be able to come to you (freely).
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا محمد بن المثنى، حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، حدثنا شعبة، عن حميد بن نافع، عن زينب بنت أم سلمة، قالت قالت أم سلمة لعائشة إنه يدخل عليك الغلام الأيفع الذي ما أحب أن يدخل على ‏.‏ قال فقالت عائشة أما لك في رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أسوة قالت إن امرأة أبي حذيفة قالت يا رسول الله إن سالما يدخل على وهو رجل وفي نفس أبي حذيفة منه شىء ‏.‏ فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أرضعيه حتى يدخل عليك ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: A woman suckled a boy from her father until he was seven years old; then she went to another man who had no son but wanted one so much that when his wife died leaving behind only their daughter, they took the child and fed it on milk. When this girl reached puberty (and became capable of sexual intercourse), Nabiyy said: "O Allah's Apostle! You have a right over her." She replied; I am not aware thereof nor do you know me well enough to claim such rights from my father or myself, so please give your permission for us both and let it be as though we were suckling each other. He (may peace ever remain with him) said: "O Allah's Apostle! You are right in saying that." So they continued sucking milk on one another until she died; then he fed her son from his own breast till the boy reached seven years old, and after this period of time passed away as well.

Narrated Abu Huraira (may peace be upon him): The Prophet said: "A woman suckled a child for three days. She went to someone else who wanted children but had none; so he took her daughter in his house until she reached puberty when the husband asked permission from Allah's Apostle that they could continue sucking milk on one another as though it were breastfeeding, and this was granted."

chapter: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer - كتاب الْمَسَاجِدِ وَمَوَاضِعِ الصَّلاَةِ
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported ahadith from the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him), and one of them is that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon), said:                      When the call is made for prayer come to it walking with tranquillity, and pray what you are in time for, and complete what you have missed.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا محمد بن رافع، حدثنا عبد الرزاق، حدثنا معمر، عن همام بن منبه، قال هذا ما حدثنا أبو هريرة، عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فذكر أحاديث منها وقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إذا نودي بالصلاة فأتوها وأنتم تمشون وعليكم السكينة فما أدركتم فصلوا وما فاتكم فأتموا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: I was asked about a man who went to Masjid al-Haram in Makkah with his wife on an odd day of Juma' Day; he entered it through its door while she stood by outside, and when they came out from the mosque together after praying Jum'a (Friday prayer), there were two men standing at either side. One man said: O Messenger! I saw you enter Masjid al-Haram with your wife on an odd day of Juma' Day; so why did not we see her? The Prophet replied, "She was behind me." He then went to the door and asked his companion who had entered first (the woman or he); but she said: You were before us. So I returned home again with my wife in a state that no one can describe it; for Allah has made this an example of those whose hearts are not satisfied until they see their wives naked."

chapter: The Book of Faith - كتاب الإيمان
ground_truth_en: It is narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Umar that the Apostle (may peace and blessings be upon him) observed on the occasion of the Farewell Pilgrimage Woe unto you distress unto you! Don't turn back as unbelievers after me by striking the necks of one another.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وأبو بكر بن خلاد الباهلي قالا حدثنا محمد بن جعفر، حدثنا شعبة، عن واقد بن محمد بن زيد، أنه سمع أباه، يحدث عن عبد الله بن عمر، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه قال في حجة الوداع ‏"‏ ويحكم - أو قال ويلكم - لا ترجعوا بعدي كفارا يضرب بعضكم رقاب بعض ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased) said: “Verily there is no one of us but he who has a friend in Paradise or Hell.” Narrated Abu Hurairah; may God have mercy on him when it was related to me that I asked about this Hadith, so the Prophet added.

chapter: The Book of Virtue; Good Manners and Joining of the Ties of Relationship - كتاب البر والصلة والآداب
ground_truth_en: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Nu'man b. Bashir through another chain of transmitters.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا ابن نمير، حدثنا حميد بن عبد الرحمن، عن الأعمش، عن الشعبي، عن النعمان، بن بشير عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم نحوه ‏.‏

chapter: The Book of Oaths - كتاب الأيمان
ground_truth_en: Zadhan reported that Ibn Umar called his slave and he found the marks (of beating) upon his back. He said to him:                      I have caused you pain. He said: No. But he (Ibn Umar) said: You are free. He then took hold of something from the earth and said: There is no reward for me even to the weight equal to it. I heard Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) as saying: He who beats a slave without cognizable offence of his or slaps him (without any serious fault), then expiation for it is that he should set him free.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا محمد بن المثنى، وابن، بشار - واللفظ لابن المثنى - قالا حدثنا محمد، بن جعفر حدثنا شعبة، عن فراس، قال سمعت ذكوان، يحدث عن زاذان، أن ابن عمر، دعا بغلام له فرأى بظهره أثرا فقال له أوجعتك قال لا ‏.‏ قال فأنت عتيق ‏.‏ قال ثم أخذ شيئا من الأرض فقال ما لي فيه من الأجر ما يزن هذا إني سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ من ضرب غلاما له حدا لم يأته أو لطمه فإن كفارته أن يعتقه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabigha bin Al-Ash'ath al-Mazini said: I heard Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) say that whoever swears by God to perform a good deed or abstain from an evil one will have it done for them, even if they are not able. And he added saying "God is sufficient as witness."

chapter: The Book Concerning the Use of Correct Words - كتاب الألفاظ من الأدب وغيرها
ground_truth_en: Abd Sa'id Khudri reported Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      There was a woman from Bani Isra'il who was short-statured and she walked in the company of two tall women with wooden sandals in her feet and a ring of gold made of plates with musk filled in them and then looked up, and musk is the best of scents; then she walked between two women and they (the people) did not recognise her, and she made a gesture with her hand like this, and Shu'ba shook his hand in order to give an indication how she shook her hand.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا أبو أسامة، عن شعبة، حدثني خليد بن جعفر، عن أبي نضرة، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ كانت امرأة من بني إسرائيل قصيرة تمشي مع امرأتين طويلتين فاتخذت رجلين من خشب وخاتما من ذهب مغلق مطبق ثم حشته مسكا وهو أطيب الطيب فمرت بين المرأتين فلم يعرفوها فقالت بيدها هكذا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ونفض شعبة يده ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabigha bin Al-Ash'ath al-Mazini narrated that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) said: "The best of deeds is to speak a good word or an honest statement." And he added saying it was better than giving charity, for its reward will not diminish. Narrated Abu Hurairah; may God have mercy on his relatives and himself in this world as well His Day (the Hereafter).

chapter: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer - كتاب الْمَسَاجِدِ وَمَوَاضِعِ الصَّلاَةِ
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported:                      Refrain from saying (the noon prayer) till the extreme heat passes away, for the Intensity of heat is from the exhalation of Hell.
ground_truth_ar: قال عمرو وحدثني أبو يونس عن أبي هريرة أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ أبردوا عن الصلاة فإن شدة الحر من فيح جهنم ‏"‏ ‏.
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: I was ordered to pray at Masjid al-Haram in Makkah; then Allah commanded me that whoever prayed there would have his sins forgiven except those of adultery or slander unless he had repented for them and sought forgiveness from the people. Then, when it became forbidden [for us] (to enter) this mosque after my death I was ordered to pray at Masjid al-Nabawi in Madinah; then Allah commanded me that whoever prayed there would have his sins forgiven except those of adultery or slander unless he had repented for them and sought forgiveness from the people. Then, when it became forbidden [for us] (to enter) this mosque after my death I was ordered to pray at Masjid al-Aqsa in Jerusalem; then Allah commanded me that whoever prayed there would have his sins forgiven except those of adultery or slander unless he had repented for them and sought forgiveness from the people. chapter: The Book of Jihad and Expedition - كتاب الجهاد والسير
ground_truth_en: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira who said:                      We were (sitting) in the mosque when the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) came to us and said: (Let us) go to the Jews. We went out with him until we came to them. The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) stood up and called out to them (saying): O ye assembly of Jews, accept Islam (and) you will be safe. They said: Abu'l-Qasim, you have communicated (God's Message to us). The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) said: I want this (i. e. you should admit that God's Message has been communicated to you), accept Islam and you would be safe. They said: Abu'l-Qisim, you have communicated (Allah's Message). The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) said: I want this... - He said to them (the same words) the third time (and on getting the same reply) he added: You should know that the earth belongs to Allah and His Apostle, and I wish that I should expel you from this land Those of you who have any property with them should sell it, otherwise they should know that the earth belongs to Allah and His Apostle (and they may have to go away leaving everything behind).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد، حدثنا ليث، عن سعيد بن أبي سعيد، عن أبيه، عن أبي، هريرة أنه قال بينا نحن في المسجد إذ خرج إلينا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال ‏"‏ انطلقوا إلى يهود ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فخرجنا معه حتى جئناهم فقام رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فناداهم فقال ‏"‏ يا معشر يهود أسلموا تسلموا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقالوا قد بلغت يا أبا القاسم ‏.‏ فقال لهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ذلك أريد أسلموا تسلموا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقالوا قد بلغت يا أبا القاسم ‏.‏ فقال لهم رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ذلك أريد ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقال لهم الثالثة فقال ‏"‏ اعلموا أنما الأرض لله ورسوله وأني أريد أن أجليكم من هذه الأرض فمن وجد منكم بماله شيئا فليبعه وإلا فاعلموا أن الأرض لله ورسوله ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased) said: I was ordered to go out in Jihad; so when it came my turn they sent me with a group of men who were all blind except myself as well.

Narrated Abu Huraira:

The Prophet Muhammad SAWS went forth on an expedition. He asked his companions, "Who will lead you?" They replied that none among them could guide others because everyone was visually impaired and unable to see the way ahead.
Then he said: I am going with a group of men who are blind except myself; so if anyone asks me about my direction in this Jihad (expedition), tell him, "I don't know." If someone else is asked for his guidance on that day then say likewise. And whoever dies before the Day [of Resurrection] will be punished and he has no right to ask others what they should do.

Narrated Abu Huraira:

The Prophet Muhammad SAWS said: I was ordered by Allah (Exalted) in Jihad; so when it came my turn, we went out with a group of men who were all blind except myself as well. So if anyone asks me about the direction [in which] to go on this day then say unto him that you don't know.

Narrated Abu Huraira:

The Prophet Muhammad SAWS said: I was ordered by Allah (Exalted) in Jihad; so when it came my turn, we went out with a group of men who were all blind except myself

chapter: The Book of Transactions - كتاب البيوع
ground_truth_en: Jabir b. Abdullah (Allah be pleased with them) reported some of the Companions of Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) had surplus of land. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) said:                      He, who has surplus land (in his possession) should cultivate it, or he should lend it to his brother for benefit, but if he refuses to accept it, he should retain it.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا الحكم بن موسى، حدثنا هقل، - يعني ابن زياد - عن الأوزاعي، عن عطاء، عن جابر بن عبد الله، قال كان لرجال فضول أرضين من أصحاب رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ من كانت له فضل أرض فليزرعها أو ليمنحها أخاه فإن أبى فليمسك أرضه ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response:
Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased) said: A man came to me asking permission from Me about a slave-girl who was owned by another person; so I asked him what he wanted of her? He replied that she had been promised as security for some debt, and if it were paid off the owner would give up his claim on this girl. So when you pay someone’s debts (as surety) then do not retain anything from them except their own property or a loan which they have to repay; otherwise what is left of your wealth will be destroyed by Allah in Hell-fire, and whoever retains it after fulfilling the obligation has committed an injustice against himself.
Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet said that there are three things upon every Muslim. They should not eat until their stomachs become empty (i.e., they have nothing to spare), nor drink till thirst is quenched; neither sleep for two nights continuously, unless it be a journey or sickness of necessity.

Nabiyy Allah sent me with the following verse: "O you who believe! Do your oaths by that which I am sending down as an example (to guide) and do not swear falsely in order to deceive people. And if ye make up for yourselves falsehood, then woe unto thee; surely thou art a transgressing one." [Al-Nisa 4:29]

chapter: The Book of Marriage - كتاب النكاح
ground_truth_en: 'Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid reported on the authority of Abdullah:                      We went to him, and I was the youngest of all (of us), but he did not mention:" I lost no time in marrying."
ground_truth_ar: حدثني عبد الله بن سعيد الأشج، حدثنا وكيع، حدثنا الأعمش، عن عمارة بن، عمير عن عبد الرحمن بن يزيد، عن عبد الله، قال دخلنا عليه وأنا أحدث القوم، بمثل حديثهم ولم يذكر فلم ألبث حتى تزوجت ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad PBUH) said: A woman may be divorced by her husband in three ways; she can say to him that he is a bad person or an evil man who has no good qualities whatsoever but if this causes strife between them, then they should go their own way. She also says it because of his poverty and inability (to provide for the family) so long as there are children in wedlock with her husband she cannot divorce him until after all these have grown up to maturity; or that he has committed adultery but if this causes strife between them, then they should go their own way. chapter: The Book of Zakat - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      There is never a day wherein servants (of God) get up at morn, but are not visited by two angels. One of them says: 0 Allah, give him more who spends (for the sake of Allah), and the other says: 0 Allah, bring destruction to one who withholds.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني القاسم بن زكريا، حدثنا خالد بن مخلد، حدثني سليمان، - وهو ابن بلال - حدثني معاوية بن أبي مزرد، عن سعيد بن يسار، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ما من يوم يصبح العباد فيه إلا ملكان ينزلان فيقول أحدهما اللهم أعط منفقا خلفا ‏.‏ ويقول الآخر اللهم أعط ممسكا تلفا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: “Zakat is a duty on every Muslim who has reached puberty.” Narrated Anas bin Malik; Abu Hurairah reported it from Ibn Abbas that he heard Al-Miqdad saying, "I have never seen anyone pay Zakah except the Ansar."

chapter: The Book on Government - كتاب الإمارة
ground_truth_en: It has been reported on the authority of Umm Haram daughter of Milhan (through another chain of transmitters). She said:                      One day the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) slept (at a place) near me. He woke up smiling. She said: Messenger of Allah. what made thee laugh? He said: A people from my followers were presented to me. They were sailing on the surface of this green sea... (here follows the tradition that has gone before).
ground_truth_ar: وحدثناه محمد بن رمح بن المهاجر، ويحيى بن يحيى، قالا أخبرنا الليث، عن  يحيى بن سعيد، عن ابن حبان، عن أنس بن مالك، عن خالته أم حرام بنت ملحان، أنها قالت نام رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يوما قريبا مني ثم استيقظ يتبسم - قالت - فقلت يا رسول الله ما أضحكك قال ‏"‏ ناس من أمتي عرضوا على يركبون ظهر هذا البحر الأخضر ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثم ذكر نحو حديث حماد بن زيد ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: I swear to Allâh that if a man is entrusted with authority over people he will use it in accordance either of two ways; one way being good or another evil." Narrated Abu Huraira, may God have mercy on his master. He added "I do not know whether the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said this about himself as well"

chapter: The Book on Government - كتاب الإمارة
ground_truth_en: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar that the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) had a race of the horses which had been especially prepared for the purpose from Hafya' to Thaniyyat al-Wada' (the latter being the winning post), and of those which had not been trained from Thaniyya to the mosque of Banu Zuraiq, and Ibn Umar was among those who took part in this race.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا يحيى بن يحيى التميمي، قال قرأت على مالك عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، ‏.‏ أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم سابق بالخيل التي قد أضمرت من الحفياء وكان أمدها ثنية الوداع وسابق بين الخيل التي لم تضمر من الثنية إلى مسجد بني زريق وكان ابن عمر فيمن سابق بها ‏.‏
llm_response:
Nabiyyah (Prophethood) is a mercy from Allah Most High; whoever accepts it willingly receives its rewards in this world as well [as] hereafter.

Narrated Abu Hurairah: The Prophet said that Nabiyyu 'an-Nabi' wa'l-Muslimun li-Malik al-Haramayn, and the Messenger of God (peace be upon him) was a man who had been given authority over two sacred places. He used to go up on Mount Arafat in Hajj season for forty days; he would fast every day except one during that time.

Narrated Abu Hurairah: The Prophet said "Nabiyyu 'an-Nabi' wa'l-Muslimun li-Malik al-Haramayn, and the Messenger of God (peace be upon him) was a man who had been given authority over two sacred places. He used to go up on Mount Arafat in Hajj season for forty days; he would fast every day except one during that time."

chapter: The Book Pertaining to Punishments Prescribed by Islam - كتاب الحدود
ground_truth_en: This hadith is narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا عمرو الناقد، وإسحاق بن إبراهيم، وعلي بن خشرم، كلهم عن عيسى، بن يونس عن الأعمش، بهذا الإسناد ‏.‏ مثله غير أنه يقول ‏"‏ إن سرق حبلا وإن سرق بيضة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: The punishment of flogging is prescribed by Allah in three cases; namely adultery with a married woman or an unmarried girl who has reached puberty without her guardian's permission [i.e., she was forced], and fornication, as well. Narrated Abu Hurairah May God have mercy on Him (may peace be upon him).

chapter: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer - كتاب الْمَسَاجِدِ وَمَوَاضِعِ الصَّلاَةِ
ground_truth_en: This hadith has been narrated by Mansur with the same chain of transmitters, with a slight modification of words.
ground_truth_ar: حدثناه أبو كريب، حدثنا ابن بشر، ح قال وحدثني محمد بن حاتم، حدثنا وكيع، كلاهما عن مسعر، عن منصور، بهذا الإسناد ‏.‏ وفي رواية ابن بشر ‏"‏ فلينظر أحرى ذلك للصواب ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وفي رواية وكيع ‏"‏ فليتحر الصواب ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: Whoever visits Masjid al-Haram in Makkah with a pure intention will be rewarded as if he had performed Hajj seven times; whoever performs Tawaf around Ka'bah once is equal to performing Umrah seventy-seven thousand and three hundred. Narrated Abu Hurairah

chapter: The Book of Pilgrimage - كتاب الحج
ground_truth_en: A'isba (Allah be pleased with her) said:                      We proceeded with the Apostle of Allah (may peace be upon him) with no other Intention but that of performing the Hajj. As I was at Sarif or near it, 1 entered in the state of menses. The Apostle of Allah (may peace be upon him) came to me and I was weeping, whereupon he said: Are you in a state of menses? I said. Yes. whereupon he said: This is what Allah has ordained for all the daughters, of Adam. Do whatever the pilgrim does. except that you should not circumambulate the House till you have washed yourself (at the end of the menses period). And the Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) offered sacrifice of a cow on behalf of his wives.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، وعمرو الناقد، وزهير بن حرب، جميعا عن ابن، عيينة - قال عمرو حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، - عن عبد الرحمن بن القاسم، عن أبيه، عن عائشة، - رضى الله عنها - قالت خرجنا مع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ولا نرى إلا الحج حتى إذا كنا بسرف أو قريبا منها حضت فدخل على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وأنا أبكي فقال ‏"‏ أنفست ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يعني الحيضة ‏.‏ - قالت - قلت نعم ‏.‏ قال ‏"‏ إن هذا شىء كتبه الله على بنات آدم فاقضي ما يقضي الحاج غير أن لا تطوفي بالبيت حتى تغتسلي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قالت وضحى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عن نسائه بالبقر ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased wiht him) said: I was ordered to go on pilgrimage in one year but did it twice; so he sent me back saying that if you had gone once then there would have been no sin upon your soul, and this is what the Messenger of God used. Narrated Abu Huraira

chapter: The Book of Transactions - كتاب البيوع
ground_truth_en: Ibn Umar (Allah be pleased with them) reported Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      Whosoever grafts the tree and then sells its roots, its fruit will belong to one who grafts it except when provision is laid down by the buyer.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا قتيبة بن سعيد، حدثنا ليث، ح وحدثنا ابن رمح، أخبرنا الليث، عن نافع، عن ابن عمر، أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال ‏"‏ أيما امرئ أبر نخلا ثم باع أصلها فللذي أبر ثمر النخل إلا أن يشترط المبتاع ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyah (Prophet Muhammad) said: A man sold a slave to me; I asked him about his condition of slavery so that he might be free from it if there was any defect in its status as such or anything else which would make this sale invalid, and the seller told us all. So we bought her for 100 dirhams (silver coins) without asking whether she had been freed by anyone before our purchase; then I asked Allah about that slave girl to see what He wanted me concerning it: "O Lord! You know best." Then She said 'I am free.' And the Prophet came and saw this woman, who was a black female. So he went up (to her) with his hand in blessing upon him saying : O God forgive us all that we have done wrongfully against your slave girl; for she is one of Your slaves whom you had made rich by giving to me as much wealth from the booty which Allah gave, and I did not know about it. So he took off her shackles (of slavery) with his hands saying : O God! You are free indeed." Then She said 'I am a slave girl.' And she went down again in chains of servitude; so they sold me for 100 dirhams to another man who asked the Prophet about my condition. chapter: The Book of Faith - كتاب الإيمان
ground_truth_en: Hudhaifa reported:                      The Messenger of Allah (may peace be upon him) narrated to us two ahadith. I have seen one (crystallized into reality), and I am waiting for the other. He told us: Trustworthiness descended in the innermost (root) of the hearts of people. Then the Qur'an was revealed and they learnt from the Qur'an and they learnt from the Sunnah. Then he (the Holy Prophet) told us about the removal of trustworthiness. He said: The man would have a wink of sleep and trustworthiness would be taken away from his heart leaving the impression of a faint mark. He would again sleep and trustworthiness would be taken away from his heart leaving an impression of a blister, as if you rolled down an ember on your foot and it was vesicled. He would see a swelling having nothing in it. He (the Holy Prophet) then took up a pebble and rolled it down over his foot and (said): The people would enter into transactions amongst one another and hardly a person would be left who would return (things) entrusted to him. (And there would be so much paucity of honest persons) till it would be said: There in such a such tribe is a trustworthy man. And they would also say about a person: How prudent he is, how broad-minded he is and how intelligent he is, whereas in his heart there would not be faith even to the weight of a mustard seed. I have passed through a time in which I did not care with whom amongst you I entered into a transaction, for if he were a Muslim his faith would compel him to discharge his obligations to me and it he were a Christian or a Jew, the ruler would compel him to discharge his obligations to me. But today I would not enter into a transaction with you except so and so.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة، حدثنا أبو معاوية، ووكيع، ح وحدثنا أبو كريب، حدثنا أبو معاوية، عن الأعمش، عن زيد بن وهب، عن حذيفة، قال حدثنا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم حديثين قد رأيت أحدهما وأنا أنتظر الآخر حدثنا ‏"‏ أن الأمانة نزلت في جذر قلوب الرجال ثم نزل القرآن فعلموا من القرآن وعلموا من السنة ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثم حدثنا عن رفع الأمانة قال ‏"‏ ينام الرجل النومة فتقبض الأمانة من قلبه فيظل أثرها مثل الوكت ثم ينام النومة فتقبض الأمانة من قلبه فيظل أثرها مثل المجل كجمر دحرجته على رجلك فنفط فتراه منتبرا وليس فيه شىء - ثم أخذ حصى فدحرجه على رجله - فيصبح الناس يتبايعون لا يكاد أحد يؤدي الأمانة حتى يقال إن في بني فلان رجلا أمينا ‏.‏ حتى يقال للرجل ما أجلده ما أظرفه ما أعقله وما في قلبه مثقال حبة من خردل من إيمان ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ولقد أتى على زمان وما أبالي أيكم بايعت لئن كان مسلما ليردنه على دينه ولئن كان نصرانيا أو يهوديا ليردنه على ساعيه وأما اليوم فما كنت لأبايع منكم إلا فلانا وفلانا ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may peace be upon him) said: I was ordered to call people from every tribe of Quraysh except Banu Hashim; but Allah revealed that it is forbidden me even so much as calling them by name or mentioning their names, and He has made lawful for Me the mention only in order not [to] forget Him.

chapter: The Book of Masaaqah - كتاب المساقاة
ground_truth_en: Hanash reported:                      We were along with Fadala b. Ubaid (Allah be pleased with him) in an expedition. There fell to my and my friend's lot a necklace made of gold, silver and jewels. I decided to buy that. I asked Fadala b. 'Ubaid, whereupon he said: Separate its gold and place it in one pan (of the balance) and place your gold in the other pan, and do not receive but equal for equal, for I heard Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) as saying: He who believes in Allah and the Hereafter should not take but equal for equal.
ground_truth_ar: حدثني أبو الطاهر، أخبرنا ابن وهب، عن قرة بن عبد الرحمن المعافري، وعمرو، بن الحارث وغيرهما أن عامر بن يحيى المعافري، أخبرهم عن حنش، أنه قال كنا مع فضالة بن عبيد في غزوة فطارت لي ولأصحابي قلادة فيها ذهب وورق وجوهر فأردت أن أشتريها فسألت فضالة بن عبيد فقال انزع ذهبها فاجعله في كفة واجعل ذهبك في كفة ثم لا تأخذن إلا مثلا بمثل فإني سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول ‏"‏ من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر فلا يأخذن إلا مثلا بمثل ‏"‏ ‏.‏

chapter: Introduction - كتاب المقدمة
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني محمد بن رافع، وحجاج بن الشاعر، قالا حدثنا عبد الرزاق، قال قال معمر ما رأيت أيوب اغتاب أحدا قط إلا عبد الكريم - يعني أبا أمية - فإنه ذكره فقال رحمه الله كان غير ثقة لقد سألني عن حديث لعكرمة ثم قال سمعت عكرمة ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased) said: “The best among my Ummah is he who learns as much of this Qur'an in one year or two years that was revealed to me.” Narrated Abu Hurairah [May God have mercy on him] and others, Sahih Muslim 1.

chapter: The Book Pertaining to the Excellent Qualities of the Holy Prophet (may Peace be upon them) and His - كتاب الفضائل
ground_truth_en: Abu Juhaifa reported:                      I saw Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him) having some whiteness (in hair) at this place, and Zuhair placed one of his fingers at his chin. Juhaifa was asked how old he had been at that time. He said: I made arrows and put feathers to them (i. e. I had passed my childhood).
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا أحمد بن يونس، حدثنا زهير، حدثنا أبو إسحاق، ح وحدثنا يحيى بن، يحيى أخبرنا أبو خيثمة، عن أبي إسحاق، عن أبي جحيفة، قال رأيت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم هذه منه بيضاء ووضع زهير بعض أصابعه على عنفقته قيل له مثل من أنت يومئذ قال أبري النبل وأريشها ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyā (peace be upon him) said: I was sent to every tribe of people except that which Allah chose from among them as its own; so whoever is with it will have me in his company on Judgment Day." Narrated Abu Huraira, may God bless and grant peace unto Him. And the Prophet Muhammad SAWS did not say this Hadith directly but narrated a similar one by another narrator who reported him saying: "I was sent to every tribe of people except that which Allah chose from among them as its own; so whoever is with it will have me in his company on Judgment Day."

chapter: The Book Pertaining to Paradise; Its Description; Its Bounties and Its Intimates - كتاب الجنة وصفة نعيمها وأهلها
ground_truth_en: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) as saying:                      When the people would stand before Allah. the Lord of the worlds, each one of them would stand submerged into perspiration up to half of his ears, and there is no mention of the" day" in the badlth transmitted on the authority of Ibn Muthanni.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا زهير بن حرب، ومحمد بن المثنى، وعبيد الله بن سعيد، قالوا حدثنا يحيى، - يعنون ابن سعيد - عن عبيد الله، أخبرني نافع، عن ابن عمر، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏ يوم يقوم الناس لرب العالمين‏}‏ قال ‏"‏ يقوم أحدهم في رشحه إلى أنصاف أذنيه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وفي رواية ابن المثنى قال ‏"‏ يقوم الناس ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لم يذكر يوم ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabigha bin Al-Ash'ath al-Mazini said: I heard Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon him) saying that Paradise is like a garden in which there are two rows of palm trees; one row has green dates while another contains red ones, and between them the angels sing praises to God.

chapter: The Book of Mosques and Places of Prayer - كتاب الْمَسَاجِدِ وَمَوَاضِعِ الصَّلاَةِ
ground_truth_en: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported:                      This verse was revealed (in this way):" Guard the prayers and the 'Asr prayer." We recited it (in this very way) so long as Allah desired. Allah, then, abrogated it and it was revealed:" Guard the prayers, and the middle prayer." A person who was sitting with Shaqiq (one of the narrators in the chain of transmitters) said: Now it implies the 'Asr prayer. Upon this al-Bara' said: I have already informed you how this (verse) was revealed and how Allah abrogated it, and Allah knows best.
ground_truth_ar: حدثنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم الحنظلي، أخبرنا يحيى بن آدم، حدثنا الفضيل بن مرزوق، عن شقيق بن عقبة، عن البراء بن عازب، قال نزلت هذه الآية حافظوا على الصلوات وصلاة العصر ‏.‏ فقرأناها ما شاء الله ثم نسخها الله فنزلت ‏{‏ حافظوا على الصلوات والصلاة الوسطى‏}‏ فقال رجل كان جالسا عند شقيق له هي إذا صلاة العصر ‏.‏ فقال البراء قد أخبرتك كيف نزلت وكيف نسخها الله ‏.‏ والله أعلم ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased by him) said: I was ordered to go out of Medina with a group in order that we might pray at Masjid al-Jami'ah [the Great Mosque]. So when it came my turn they asked me whether there were any people praying behind us. When he replied 'No', the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) said: "Then let them go first." Narrated Abu Hurairah

chapter: The Book of Zakat - كتاب الزكاة
ground_truth_en: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of the brother of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters, but no mention has been made of the word" muz'a" (piece).
ground_truth_ar: وحدثني عمرو الناقد، حدثني إسماعيل بن إبراهيم، أخبرنا معمر، عن أخي الزهري، بهذا الإسناد ‏.‏ مثله ولم يذكر ‏"‏ مزعة ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah Muhammad (peace be upon him) said: Zakat is a duty on every Muslim who has reached puberty; it does away with poverty in this world as well after death by raising up those whose livelihood depends entirely or partially to Allah's pleasure, and removes hardship from them too. It purifies the wealth of its owner so that he may spend his life enjoying what remains for himself (after fulfilling Zakat).

chapter: The Book on Government - كتاب الإمارة
ground_truth_en: The same tradition has been narrated on the authority of Urwat al-Bariqi who said that the Prophet (may peace be upon him) said:                      Great good is attached to the forelock of the horses until the Day of Judgment.
ground_truth_ar: وحدثنا محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير، حدثنا أبي، حدثنا زكرياء، عن عامر، عن  عروة البارقي، قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الخيل معقود في نواصيها الخير إلى يوم القيامة الأجر والمغنم ‏"‏ ‏.‏
