chapter: The Book of the Etiquette of Judges - كتاب آداب القضاة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Sulaiman bin Yasar that Ibn 'Abbas told him:                     "A woman from Khath'am asked the Messenger of Allah [SAW] a question when Al-Fadl was riding behind the Messenger of Allah [SAW]. She said: 'O Messenger of Allah, the command of Allah, the Mighty and Sublime, to His slaves to perform Hajj has come while my father is an old man, he cannot sit upright in the saddle. Will it suffice if I perform Hajj on his behalf?' He said: 'Yes.'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني عمرو بن عثمان، قال حدثنا الوليد، عن الأوزاعي، قال أخبرني ابن شهاب، ح وأخبرني محمود بن خالد، قال حدثنا عمر، عن الأوزاعي، حدثني الزهري، عن سليمان بن يسار، أن ابن عباس، أخبره أن امرأة من خثعم استفتت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم والفضل رديف رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقالت يا رسول الله إن فريضة الله عز وجل في الحج على عباده أدركت أبي شيخا كبيرا لا يستطيع أن يستوي على الراحلة فهل يجزئ قال محمود فهل يقضي - أن أحج عنه فقال لها ‏"‏ نعم ‏"‏‏.‏ قال أبو عبد الرحمن وقد روى هذا الحديث غير واحد عن الزهري فلم يذكر فيه ما ذكر الوليد بن مسلم‏.‏

chapter: The Book of Hajj - كتاب مناسك الحج
ground_truth_en: Ibn 'abbas said:                     "The Messenger of Allah said: 'Perform Hajj and 'Umrah consecutively; for they remove poverty and sin as the bellows removes impurity from iron.'''
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أبو داود، قال حدثنا أبو عتاب، قال حدثنا عزرة بن ثابت، عن عمرو بن دينار، قال قال ابن عباس قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تابعوا بين الحج والعمرة فإنهما ينفيان الفقر والذنوب كما ينفي الكير خبث الحديد ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may Allah be pleased) said: Whoever performs Tawaf around Safa after he has performed Sa'i between Al-Safa' an-Nadwa is exempted from Hajj until his death or unless there was a valid reason for him to perform it before the day of Dhu al-Hijjah.

chapter: The Book of Seeking Refuge with Allah - كتاب الاستعاذة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Farwah bin Nawfal said:                     "I asked the Mother of the Believers 'Aishah about what the Messenger of Allah [SAW] used to say in his supplication. She said: 'He used to say: A'udhu bika min sharri ma 'amiltu wa min sharri ma lam a'mal ba'd (I seek refuge with You from the evil of what I have done and the evil of what I have not done yet.)'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرني محمد بن قدامة، عن جرير، عن منصور، عن هلال بن يساف، عن فروة بن نوفل، قال سألت أم المؤمنين عائشة عما كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يدعو قالت كان يقول ‏"‏ أعوذ بك من شر ما عملت ومن شر ما لم أعمل ‏"‏ ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyy (may Allah be pleased) said: I sought refuge in Allaah from every evil that is beneath me; then He sent to my right a man who was blind but he could see with his heart what others saw only by their eyes." And when this person came, we asked him about the Prophet Muhammad. So they told us of Him and His Messenger (peace be upon them). Then I sought refuge in Allaah from every evil that is beneath me; then He sent to my left a man who was blind but he could see with his heart what others saw only by their eyes." And when this person came, we asked him about the Prophet Muhammad. So they told us of Him and His Messenger (peace be upon them). Then I sought refuge in Allaah from every evil that is beneath me; then He sent to my left a man who was blind but he could see with his heart what others saw only by their eyes." chapter: The Book of Seeking Refuge with Allah - كتاب الاستعاذة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated from Sulaiman bin Yasar that he heard Abu Hurairah say:                     "I heard the Messenger of Allah [SAW] say in his supplication: 'Allahumma, inni a'udhu bika min fitnatil-qabri, wa fitnatid-dajjali, wa fitnatil-mahya wal-mamat (O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the trial of the grave, and the tribulation of the Dajjal, and the trials of life and death.)'"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا أبو عاصم، قال حدثنا القاسم بن كثير المقرئ، عن الليث بن سعد، عن يزيد بن أبي حبيب، عن سليمان بن يسار، أنه سمع أبا هريرة، يقول سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول في دعائه ‏"‏ اللهم إني أعوذ بك من فتنة القبر وفتنة الدجال وفتنة المحيا والممات ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قال أبو عبد الرحمن هذا خطأ والصواب سليمان بن سنان ‏.‏

chapter: The Book of Funerals - كتاب الجنائز
ground_truth_en: Abu lyas Mu'awiyah bin 'Qurrah narrated from his father that:                     a man came to the Prophet accompanied by a son of his. He said to him: "Do you love him?" He said: "May Allah love you as I love him." Then he (the son) died and he noticed his absence and asked about him. He said: "Will it not make you happy to know that you will not come to any of the gates of Paradise but you will find him there, trying to open it for you?"
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا عمرو بن علي، قال حدثنا يحيى، قال حدثنا شعبة، قال حدثنا أبو إياس، - وهو معاوية بن قرة - عن أبيه، رضى الله عنه أن رجلا، أتى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم ومعه ابن له فقال له ‏"‏ أتحبه ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فقال أحبك الله كما أحبه ‏.‏ فمات ففقده فسأل عنه فقال ‏"‏ ما يسرك أن لا تأتي بابا من أبواب الجنة إلا وجدته عنده يسعى يفتح لك ‏"‏ ‏.‏

chapter: The Book of Fasting - كتاب الصيام
ground_truth_en: It was narrated form Muhammad bin Sad Abi Waqqas, from his father, that:                     the Prophet struck one hand with the other and said: "The month is like this and like this and like this," retaining one finger the third time.
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا إسحاق بن إبراهيم، قال حدثنا محمد بن بشر، عن إسماعيل بن أبي خالد، عن محمد بن سعد بن أبي وقاص، عن أبيه، عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم أنه ضرب بيده على الأخرى وقال ‏"‏ الشهر هكذا وهكذا وهكذا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ونقص في الثالثة إصبعا ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah (may Allah be pleased to him) said: “The fasting of a person is like his prayer.” And he added that it was better than two hundred prayers because there are many kinds in them; but this fast has only one kind, and its reward lies with Him Who knows the unseen.

chapter: The Book of Drinks - كتاب الأشربة
ground_truth_en: It was narrated that Ash-Sha'bi said:                     "Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, used to give the people thickened grape juice into which flies would fall and not be able to get out again."
ground_truth_ar: أخبرنا سويد، قال أنبأنا عبد الله، عن جرير، عن مغيرة، عن الشعبي، قال كان علي رضى الله عنه يرزق الناس الطلاء يقع فيه الذباب ولا يستطيع أن يخرج منه ‏.‏
llm_response: Nabiyyullah said: Whoever drinks wine (al-sharāb) will never be among those who are righteous in this world or hereafter except as a result of ignorance; whoever eats it is like one whose hand has been burnt by fire so that he cannot eat anything for three days. Narrated Abu Hurairah
